Given a metrically scaled 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model, RIDE combines sparse metric depth observations derived from PnP-RANSAC inlier correspondences with the geometric prior of a pretrained video-depth model. To handle uneven and intermittent observations, it integrates global and local depth correction with temporal memory, supporting depth estimation through short observation gaps after metric scale initialization. Trained on public RGB-D videos, RIDE is evaluated on robot sequences without fine tuning. Experiments show improved depth accuracy and temporal consistency over scale-only calibration, demonstrating how localization geometry can support both pose recovery and dense robot perception.
summary_zh: 渲染-匹配-PnP重定位方法可建立查询图像像素与3D地图点的对应关系以恢复相机位姿，但其支撑稠密深度估计的潜力长期被忽视。为充分利用该几何信息，本文提出RIDE方法，可从机器人RGB流中估计稠密度量深度。给定经过度量尺度标定的3DGS（3D高斯溅射）模型，RIDE将从PnP-RANSAC内点对应关系中得到的稀疏度量深度观测，与预训练视频深度模型的几何先验相融合。为应对观测分布不均、间歇性中断的问题，该方法结合全局与局部深度校正和时间记忆机制，在完成度量尺度初始化后，可在存在短时间观测缺口的情况下持续输出深度估计结果。在公开RGB-D视频数据集上完成训练后，RIDE无需微调即可在机器人序列上完成评估。实验结果表明，相比仅做尺度标定的方法，RIDE的深度精度和时间一致性均有明显提升，验证了定位几何信息可同时支撑位姿恢复与机器人稠密感知任务。

title: Freehand Sketching for End-User Programming of Robot Swarms
title_zh: 面向机器人群集终端用户编程的徒手草图绘制方法
authors: Riwa Karam, Ian Kuo, Magnus Egerstedt
abstract: Robot swarms are increasingly used in applications where accessible interaction with non-expert users is desirable. This paper investigates freehand sketching as an end-user programming interface for specifying robot swarm geometries. Users communicate spatial intent through a drawing, while the swarm autonomously extracts target formation points, constructs a rigid formation graph, assigns robots to formation nodes, and executes distributed formation control with a guarantee against unintended reflected formations. The resulting sketch-to-swarm framework is evaluated through a human study examining the usability of freehand formation specification. Twenty participants generated $42$ geometric shapes, and the interface achieved a mean System Usability Scale score of $84.25$, which conventionally indicates high perceived usability. The results support freehand sketching as an intuitive interaction abstraction for human-swarm collaboration without requiring robotics or programming expertise.
summary_zh: 机器人群集正逐步应用于需要非专业用户便捷交互的场景中。本文研究将徒手草图绘制作为指定机器人群集几何构型的终端用户编程接口，用户通过绘图传递空间意图，群集则自主提取目标编队点、构建刚性编队图、为编队节点分配机器人，并执行分布式编队控制，同时可避免出现非预期的镜像编队。本文通过用户研究评估了该草图转群集框架的徒手编队指定可用性，20名参与者共绘制了42种几何形状，接口的平均系统可用性量表（SUS）得分为84.25，按照通用标准属于高感知可用性水平。研究结果证明，徒手草图绘制是人机群集协作的直观交互抽象，无需用户掌握机器人或编程专业知识。

title: Gait-Dependent Effects on Quadruped Locomotion for Load-Carrying using Passive Mechanism
title_zh: 采用被动机构的负载承载四足机器人运动的步态相关效应研究
authors: Giovanni B. Dessy, Claudio Semini, Victor Barasuol
abstract: Passive mechanical interfaces offer a lightweight alternative to actuated manipulators for quadruped payload carrying, but their impedance directly couples the payload dynamics with the locomotion pattern. This paper analyzes how passive-arm stiffness-damping selection affects payload-carrying locomotion under different gait and payload conditions. We compare damped and underdamped passive-arm impedance configurations in simulation during flat-ground locomotion. For crawl gaits, where the support polygon remains well defined, the results show that underdamped impedance increases passive-joint oscillations and can reduce the ZMP margin with respect to the support polygon. Trot is retained as a dynamic excitation case for the passive arm, but it is not used for direct ZMP-margin stability comparison. The results are summarized in gait-payload-stiffness-damping maps, where ZMP-margin reduction is evaluated for crawl gaits and trot is retained only as a passive-arm excitation case.
summary_zh: 被动机械接口是四足机器人负载承载场景下替代驱动机械臂的轻量化方案，但其阻抗特性会直接将负载动力学与运动步态耦合。本文分析了不同步态和负载条件下，被动臂的刚度-阻尼参数选择对负载承载运动的影响，在仿真环境中对比了平地运动场景下阻尼和欠阻尼两种被动臂阻抗配置。结果表明，对于支撑多边形定义明确的爬行步态，欠阻尼阻抗会增大被动关节振荡，还会降低相对于支撑多边形的ZMP（零力矩点）裕度。小跑步态作为被动臂的动态激励场景保留，不直接用于ZMP裕度稳定性对比。研究结果整理为步态-负载-刚度-阻尼映射图，其中针对爬行步态评估ZMP裕度下降情况，小跑步态仅作为被动臂激励场景使用。

title: LTLDiff: Finite Linear Temporal Logic-Guided Data Generation and Diffusion Policies for Multi-agent Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: LTLDiff：面向多智能体机器人操作的有限线性时序逻辑引导数据生成与扩散策略
authors: Chuhan Meng, Haiyan Yin
abstract: Multi-agent robotic manipulation tasks require coordination among agents to satisfy task-level temporal, logical, and safety constraints. Recently, diffusion policies have been used to perform the task. However, they still suffer from desynchronization, incorrect action ordering, and coordination failures in tasks that require simultaneous or sequential multi-agent interaction. Therefore, LTLDiff is proposed as a framework that combines Finite Linear Temporal Logic (LTLf) specification learning for both the generation of demonstrations and learning via diffusion policies. Each task has a specific LTLf formula that is learned from a set of natural language instructions using a large-scale language model. To enable a fixed-dimensional vector embedding of the learned specification from the language model, LTLf uses an abstract syntax tree representation scheme. This embedding of logic serves as a condition for (i) logic-guided data collection and (ii) diffusion-based policy training, encouraging trajectories that are consistent with the desired ordering and coordination requirements. Experiments on multi-agent LTLDiff manipulation tasks demonstrate improved task success rates compared to the baseline. Together, these contributions demonstrate the effectiveness of LTLDiff for coordinated multi-agent manipulation.
summary_zh: 多智能体机器人操作任务需要智能体之间相互协同，满足任务层面的时序、逻辑和安全约束。近年来扩散策略被用于完成这类任务，但在需要多智能体同步或序贯交互的场景中，仍存在动作不同步、动作顺序错误、协同失败等问题。为此本文提出LTLDiff框架，融合LTLf（有限线性时序逻辑）规范学习能力，同时支撑演示数据生成和扩散策略训练。每个任务对应的特定LTLf公式由大语言模型从自然语言指令集中学习得到，为将大模型输出的学习规范编码为固定维度的向量嵌入，LTLf采用抽象语法树表示方案。该逻辑嵌入可作为两个模块的条件：①逻辑引导的数据采集，②基于扩散的策略训练，最终输出的轨迹可满足期望的动作顺序和协同要求。多智能体LTLDiff操作任务的实验结果表明，相比基线方法，该框架的任务成功率有明显提升，验证了LTLDiff在多智能体协同操作场景下的有效性。

title: Topological Necessities: Mechanism-Invariant Strategic Subgoals for Cross-Embodiment Goal-Conditioned Control
title_zh: 拓扑必要条件：面向跨具身目标条件控制的机构不变战略子目标
authors: Hao Shi, Xi Li
abstract: Long-horizon goal-conditioned reinforcement learning delegates control to a high-level module that proposes subgoals, but existing subgoals are implicit byproducts of value functions or latent actions, tied to the executor that produced them. We study a different object: a route-conditioned order of unavoidable stages that every successful executor must traverse, recoverable from offline trajectories and belonging to none of them. Its defining properties are topological: an unskippable stage is a separating set that every admissible path must cross, and a loop in free space forces a route choice. We read the two by homology in dimensions 0 and 1 over a transport-weighted carrier built from successful trajectories, yielding an enumerable gate set with shell-level certificates; the certified gates are what we call topological necessities. Certified gates enter the decision loop as a recursive topological gate hierarchy. Under a fixed, isomorphic free space, the object survives executor replacement: gates frozen on PointMaze data transfer without retraining to Ant and Humanoid, attaining the highest Humanoid aggregate under a unified interface (96.1), with +36.0 over a map-privileged reference on the multi-route task (p=1.4e-5); the planner saturates PointMaze (100+/-0) and matches or exceeds the strongest baselines on AntMaze (giant +22.9) and Kitchen (+15.8/+12.6).
summary_zh: 长周期目标条件强化学习通常将控制任务委托给提出子目标的高层模块，但现有子目标是价值函数或隐式动作的隐式副产品，与生成子目标的执行器强绑定。本文研究一类完全不同的对象：所有成功执行器都必须经过的不可避免阶段的路径条件序列，该序列可从离线轨迹中恢复，且不属于任何特定执行器。其核心属性是拓扑性：不可跳过的阶段是所有可行路径都必须穿过的分离集，自由空间中的环路会强制产生路径选择。本文基于成功轨迹构建的传输加权载体，通过0维和1维同调运算提取上述两类属性，得到可枚举的门控集合与壳层级别的证明，这类经过证明的门控被称为拓扑必要条件。经过验证的门控作为递归拓扑门控层级进入决策回路。在固定同构的自由空间中，该对象不受执行器替换的影响：基于PointMaze数据训练得到的门控无需重新训练即可迁移到Ant和人形机器人平台，在统一接口下人形机器人的综合得分达到96.1，相比多路径任务下享有地图特权的参考基线高出36.0（p=1.4e-5）；该规划器在PointMaze场景下达到100±0的满分性能，在AntMaze（巨型场景得分提升22.9）和Kitchen场景（得分提升15.8/12.6）上的性能也匹配或超过现有最优基线。

title: A Mathematical Theory of Pragmatic Information
title_zh: 语用信息的数学理论
authors: Kai Niu, Ping Zhang
abstract: We propose a pragmatic information theory unifying communication, control, and decision-making. Its core is the isoteleia mapping, formalizing equifinality: distinct semantic paths leading to the same optimal action are pragmatically equivalent. This induces a three-tier hierarchy of syntactic, semantic, and pragmatic information, each abstraction discarding task-irrelevant distinctions. We develop pragmatic entropy, up/down mutual information, channel capacity, and rate-distortion, and prove three coding theorems generalizing Shannon's classical results. We introduce pragmatic value (VoI) and cost (CoI) of information as decision-theoretic duals to rate-distortion and capacity, respectively, and formulate a Lagrangian dual framework for cross-layer optimization. The pragmatic efficiency bound $\mathcal{E}_p(\lambda)=\sup_R[\Phi_p(R)-\lambda\,\mathrm{CoI}_p(R)]$ quantifies the maximum net utility any resource-constrained intelligent system can extract, thereby establishing a fundamental behavioral capacity limit---generalizing Shannon's symbol-level capacity to goal-directed action. Extensions to continuous messages yield closed-form Gaussian expressions, while dynamic settings are addressed via a Bellman equation for sequential decision-making. This framework provides a rigorous foundation for task-oriented communication, networked control, autonomous systems, and embodied AI, shifting focus from symbol fidelity to the effectiveness of information in guiding actions, and offers a unified mathematical language for next-generation intelligent systems.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种统一通信、控制与决策的语用信息理论，其核心是isoteleia映射（等终性映射），用于形式化等终性概念：即指向同一最优动作的不同语义路径在语用层面是等价的。该理论构建了句法信息、语义信息、语用信息的三层层级结构，每一层抽象都会丢弃与任务无关的区分特征。本文提出了语用熵、上下互信息、信道容量、率失真等核心概念，并证明了三个可推广香农经典结论的编码定理。我们进一步引入语用信息价值（VoI）与语用信息成本（CoI），作为率失真和容量在决策论层面的对偶概念，构建了面向跨层优化的拉格朗日对偶框架。语用效率界$\mathcal{E}_p(\lambda)=\sup_R[\Phi_p(R)-\lambda\,\mathrm{CoI}_p(R)]$可量化任意资源受限智能系统能够获取的最大净效用，由此建立了基础行为容量极限——将香农的符号级容量推广到了面向目标的动作层面。该框架可扩展至连续消息场景，得到闭式高斯表达式，动态场景则通过面向序贯决策的贝尔曼方程求解。本研究为面向任务的通信、网络控制、自主系统与具身人工智能提供了严谨的理论基础，将研究重心从符号保真度转向信息对动作的引导有效性，为下一代智能系统提供了统一的数学语言。

title: Testing Between the Test Cases: Proving End-to-End Steering in Conditions You Never Drove
title_zh: 测试用例间验证：在从未行驶过的场景下证明端到端转向能力
authors: Menuka Ghalan, Charles Rodgers, Zachary D. Asher
abstract: AI-based automated vehicle testing is challenging because a model that passes every test condition can still fail in the real world. Formal verification offers a way to directly address this gap. On a simulated highway and an arterial road we trained two small end-to-end steering networks each in CARLA, one on clear conditions alone and one on clear, fog, night and low sun. All four models were driven against a 2.19 ft lane-departure budget. Without driving again, we used bound propagation, a formal method that reads the trained weights, to compute how far steering can drift at every disturbance strength between two captured images. One calculation covers more than a campaign could drive: on the arterial it spans 133 poses, where ten intensities each would be 10^133 combinations, in minutes on one GPU. Not only did formal verification find conditions that broke the clear-trained policy without simulation testing, it provided some preliminary evidence for potential failures between the test cases. Our overall conclusion is that formal verification is a viable complement to simulation, and could be adopted as a part of verification and validation for automated driving.
summary_zh: 基于人工智能的自动驾驶测试面临巨大挑战：即使模型通过了所有预设测试场景，在真实环境中仍可能失效。形式化验证为解决这一问题提供了可行路径。本文在CARLA仿真平台的高速公路与城市主干道场景下训练了两个小型端到端转向网络：一个仅在晴朗天气场景下训练，另一个在晴朗、雾天、夜间、低光照场景下训练。所有四个模型均满足2.19英尺的车道偏离阈值要求。无需额外实车/仿真行驶，我们使用边界传播这一可读取训练权重的形式化方法，计算两张捕获图像之间任意扰动强度下的转向漂移范围。单次计算覆盖的场景量远超大规模路试：在城市主干道场景下可覆盖133个位姿，每个位姿对应10种扰动强度，总场景组合量达$10^{133}$，仅需单块GPU数分钟即可完成计算。形式化验证不仅无需仿真测试就发现了仅在晴朗场景训练的策略的失效场景，还为测试用例间隙的潜在失效提供了初步证据。研究结果表明，形式化验证可作为仿真测试的有效补充，能够融入自动驾驶的验证与确认流程。

title: ObstaDiff: Generalizable Diffusion Policy Learning via Obstacle-aware Representations
title_zh: ObstaDiff：基于障碍物感知表征的可泛化扩散策略学习
authors: Jiawen Wang, Kevin Yao, Khalid Jawed
abstract: Imitation learning has achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation, yet most existing approaches assume clean backgrounds and lack explicit mechanisms for obstacle-aware motion generation. Extending such policies to cluttered, real-world scenes with unstructured obstacles remains a key generalization challenge. We present ObstaDiff, a decomposed diffusion-policy framework with a lightweight obstacle-aware visual encoder. ObstaDiff extracts a structured target-obstacle-background representation, enabling the downstream alignment policy to generate end-effector trajectories toward a target-centered bottleneck pose while reasoning about surrounding obstacles. We evaluate ObstaDiff on 61 real-robot greenhouse trials per method (366 executions in total). ObstaDiff achieves 75.41% average task success and 8.20% average obstacle collision rate, outperforming representative imitation-learning baselines and improving generalization in cluttered agricultural scenes.
summary_zh: 模仿学习在机器人操控领域已取得优异表现，但现有多数方法假设背景干净，缺乏显式的障碍物感知运动生成机制。将这类策略推广到存在非结构化障碍物的杂乱真实场景，仍是泛化性能提升的核心挑战。本文提出ObstaDiff，一种带轻量级障碍物感知视觉编码器的分解式扩散策略框架。ObstaDiff可提取结构化的目标-障碍物-背景表征，让下游对齐策略在推理周围障碍物的同时，生成指向以目标为中心的瓶颈位姿的末端执行器轨迹。我们在真实机器人温室场景下对每个方法开展61次试验，总计366次执行。ObstaDiff的平均任务成功率达75.41%，平均障碍物碰撞率为8.20%，性能超过代表性模仿学习基线方法，在杂乱农业场景下的泛化能力得到显著提升。

title: Planning along Differentiable Charts of Constraint Manifolds with General-Purpose IK Solvers
title_zh: 基于通用逆运动学求解器的约束流形可微图表轨迹规划
authors: Thomas Cohn, Seiji Shaw, Harel Biggie, Travis Manderson, Nicholas Roy 等 (6 人)
abstract: Planning trajectories for robot manipulators under kinematic equality constraints restricts feasible motions to a measure-zero submanifold of the configuration space, requiring special algorithmic treatment. A promising strategy is parametrizing the set of feasible configurations using analytic inverse kinematics (IK). Bespoke analytic IK functions can be written to be differentiable, a necessary property for gradient-based trajectory optimization. But the vast majority of IK functions are computed by automated meta-solvers like IKFast, and are difficult to modify for differentiability. We present a new approach for computing gradients of analytic IK parameterizations: we leverage the inverse function theorem to recover the desired gradients from the ordinary forward kinematic Jacobian. Furthermore, we present a least-squares domain extension and an optimization-amenable description of the reachability constraint, which preserves gradient signal outside the reachable workspace. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach through numerical experiments and downstream tasks, including a hardware demonstration of an RB-Y1 picking up a box and placing it on a table. Project website:this https URL
summary_zh: 针对带运动学等式约束的机器人机械臂轨迹规划问题，可行运动被限制在构型空间的零测度子流形上，需要特殊的算法处理。一种有前景的思路是使用解析逆运动学（Inverse Kinematics, IK）对可行构型集进行参数化。定制的解析IK函数可被设计为可微形式，这是基于梯度的轨迹优化的必要属性。但绝大多数IK函数由IKFast等自动元求解器生成，难以修改以满足可微性要求。本文提出了一种计算解析IK参数化梯度的新方法：利用反函数定理从普通的正向运动学雅可比矩阵中恢复所需梯度。此外，本文提出了最小二乘域扩展方法和面向优化的可达性约束描述，可在可达工作空间外保留梯度信号。我们通过数值实验和下游任务验证了该方法的有效性，包含RB-Y1机器人抓取盒子并放置到桌面的硬件演示。项目主页见提供的链接。

title: ReactHuman: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Human-Like Reactive Decision-Making in Embodied Multimodal LLMs
title_zh: 协变量偏移与概念偏移的通用量化方法
authors: Yizhan Li, Jianxin You, Mengyang Xiong, Yinhuan Chen, Zicheng Zhao 等 (8 人)
abstract: Reacting to sudden physical hazards (catching a slipping plate, dodging a falling knife) is both a meaningful test of embodied intelligence and a hard requirement for deploying multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as the decision coreof household robots. Existing evaluations, however, probe intuitive physics passively through question answering over videos, or target deliberate, long-horizon tasks such as navigation and rearrangement; none measure whether a model can turn physical understanding into immediate, safety-critical action. We introduce ReactHuman, the first physics-grounded benchmark for human-like reactive decision-making, in which the evaluated MLLM acts as the brain of a simulated humanoid facing sudden household hazards; it spans 17 event families and over 1,000 bit-for-bit reproducible scenes with exact, annotation-free ground truth derived from 240 Hz rigid-body simulation, including adversarial objects whose appearance contradicts their physics (a foam anvil, a steel apple). We further design a five-metric suite that scores each reaction along three axes: reasonable, safe, and physically grounded. We physically execute every committed plan so that decisions have observable consequences. With this harness we evaluate seven representative MLLMs. Results show that reactive safety is far from solved: models mishandle roughly one hazard in three, act from fixed dispositions rather than the observed scene, trust appearance over motion, and miss interception points at meter scale even when the chosen action is correct; none of these failures shrink with model scale. ReactHuman thus offers both a fine-grained diagnosis and a scalable training signal toward physically grounded, safety-aware embodied agents. The benchmark can be found here:this https URL
summary_zh: 分布偏移下的泛化性能是现代机器学习的核心挑战，但现有学习界理论仅局限于狭窄的理想场景，无法从样本中直接估计。本文填补了理论与实际应用之间的空白：首先指出现有概念偏移定义在源域和目标域支撑集不匹配时会失效，基于熵最优传输提出了$\gamma^{*}$-概念偏移这一核心概念，推导了统一协变量偏移与$\gamma^{*}$-概念偏移的通用误差界，该误差界适用于广泛的损失函数、标签空间和随机标注场景。本文进一步提出了带集中性保证的偏移估计器，以及DataShifts算法，可在绝大多数应用场景下量化分布偏移并估计误差界，为分布偏移下的学习误差分析提供了严谨通用的工具。

title: Expressive Robotic Pianist: Mastering Complex Piano Repertoire with Graph-Mimic and Musical Dynamics
authors: Yanhong Liang, Xianwei Liu, Chaojie Fu, Shaowen Cheng, Yanyan Yuan 等 (10 人)
abstract: Enabling robots to perform musical instruments with human-level expressivity represents a frontier in bridging the gap between mechanical precision and artistic interpretation. Despite advances in robotic dexterity, replicating the fluid finger transitions and nuanced dynamic control characteristic of human pianists remains a significant challenge. Through a reinforcement learning-based control framework, we demonstrate that a dexterous robotic hand can achieve high-fidelity performance across a diverse piano repertoire. Central to our approach is a graph-based optimization strategy that guides the robot to generate natural pre-press and key-press fingering strategies that closely resemble human movement patterns. To achieve expressive sound production, the control system is coupled with a physics-inspired acoustic model that modulates keypress velocity to accurately reproduce the dynamic variations specified in musical scores. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate that our expressive control model significantly outperforms baseline methods in both finger morphology similarity and dynamic velocity accuracy. In a perceptual test involving participants from diverse listener groups, performances generated by our system are significantly preferred over baseline robotic performances and are indistinguishable from human performances for non-professional audiences. Furthermore, extensive experiments across multiple musical styles confirm that our method maintains high note-level accuracy while achieving expressive performance. Our approach provides a robust pathway for robotic systems to move beyond mere mechanical accuracy, elevating robotic musicianship to a level of expressive performance comparable to human pianists.

title: Lie-Algebraic Bell Recurrences for Arbitrary-Order Twist Jets and Parallel-Mechanism Closure
title_zh: 面向任意阶扭转喷注与并联机构闭环的李代数贝尔递推方法
authors: Daniel Condurache
abstract: This paper develops an arbitrary-order kinematic construction that links serial propagation, parallel-mechanism closure, and rigid-platform point fields within one dual screw framework. A cylindrical joint is retained as one native physical block, with revolute and prismatic joints obtained as special cases. For each fixed joint axis, ordinary Bell polynomials organize the derivatives of the exponential factor; across a chain, the noncommuting factors remain in their physical order. Initial-frame prefix and terminal-resolved covariant formulas then produce equivalent representations of the serial twist jet. For a parallel mechanism, repeated Leibniz differentiation, with joint-level derivatives organized by Bell polynomials, yields an arbitrary-order triangular active-passive closure recurrence: the same passive Jacobian is solved at every derivative order at a regular configuration, while the right-hand side contains only prescribed active data and lower-order jets. The resulting platform twist jet is mapped exactly to the point-independent affine invariants of the velocity, acceleration, jerk, and snap fields. The validation is deliberately complementary: a generic 3C chain with noncoplanar axes and nonzero rotational and translational cylindrical coordinates tests ordered serial propagation, an RR+RRR spherical wrist tests active-passive closure, and a Hunt-type 6-RUS mechanism with six active revolute joints tests an independently reconstructed platform jet and its affine fields. Independent differentiation of the rigid motion, evaluation of the affine fields, and the differentiated branch closures all agree through fourth order with residuals below $10^{-12}$ in the corresponding SI units. The formulation is purely kinematic and applies at configurations where the selected active-passive partition is regular.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种任意阶运动学构建方法，在统一对偶旋量框架下串联起串联机构运动传递、并联机构闭环、刚性平台点场三类问题。该框架将圆柱关节作为原生物理模块，转动关节和移动关节作为其特殊情况处理。对于每个固定关节轴，使用普通贝尔多项式组织指数因子的导数；在整个运动链中，非对易因子保持其物理顺序不变。基于初始坐标系前缀形式和终端求解协变公式，可得到串联扭转喷注的等价表示。针对并联机构，通过莱布尼茨重复求导、使用贝尔多项式组织关节级导数，得到任意阶三角化的主动-被动闭环递推关系：在正则构型下，每阶导数仅需求解同一个被动雅可比矩阵，等式右侧仅包含给定的主动输入数据和低阶喷注结果。最终得到的平台扭转喷注可精确映射到速度、加速度、加加速度、加加加速度场的点无关仿射不变量。本文设计了互补的验证方案：非共面轴、同时包含转动和平动分量的通用3C运动链测试有序串联传递性能，RR+RRR球形手腕测试主动-被动闭环性能，带6个主动转动关节的Hunt型6-RUS机构测试独立重构的平台喷注及其仿射场。刚体运动独立求导、仿射场计算、分支闭环求导的结果在四阶以内完全一致，对应国际单位制下的残差低于$10^{-12}$。该方法完全基于运动学原理，适用于主动-被动关节划分处于正则状态的所有构型。

title: When Information is Worth the Risk: Behavioral Valuation for Hazardous Robotic Exploration
title_zh: 当信息值得冒险：危险机器人探索的行为价值评估方法
authors: Alkesh K. Srivastava, Aamodh Suresh, Carlos Nieto-Granda, Philip Dames
abstract: Hazardous robotic exploration requires robots to map spatial risks, such as unsafe terrain, radiation, fire, mines, or structural damage, while operating where collecting information can itself cause failure. A highly informative path may expose the robot to hazards, terminate execution, and prevent future observations. Hazardous exploration therefore requires deciding not only where uncertainty is largest, but when reducing it is worth the risk. This paper introduces a valuation-layer view of this problem. We keep the belief update, sensor model, physical risk model, and finite-horizon informative planner fixed, and change only the scalar objective used to rank feasible paths. Within this framework, we introduce a risk-augmented Behavioral Information objective based on Prelec probability weighting, yielding an interpretable family of conservative-to-aggressive information-risk valuations. Theoretically, we show that valuation parameters create switching boundaries between high-information/high-risk and lower-information/lower-risk paths, and induce a transformed Pareto-frontier structure over feasible exploration policies. Large-scale failure-truncated grid-world experiments show that valuation alone reshapes the information-risk frontier. Shannon information planning remains a strong raw-information baseline, while risk-aware objectives can reduce hazard exposure and robot losses by avoiding failures that truncate future sensing. Risk-augmented Behavioral valuation is Pareto-competitive with standard risk-aware baselines and provides interpretable conservative and intermediate regimes. These results support a framework in which robots reason not only about how much uncertainty an action reduces, but whether that reduction is worth the risk required to obtain it.
summary_zh: 危险场景机器人探索要求机器人在存在不安全地形、辐射、火灾、地雷、结构损伤的环境中绘制空间风险地图，而信息采集过程本身就可能导致机器人失效。高信息增益路径可能让机器人暴露在危险中，导致任务终止、后续观测中断。因此危险场景探索不仅需要判断哪里的不确定性最高，还需要判断降低该不确定性的收益是否值得承担对应的风险。本文从价值评估层面对该问题展开研究：固定信念更新规则、传感器模型、物理风险模型、有限视界信息规划器，仅改变用于排序可行路径的标量目标函数。在该框架下，我们基于Prelec概率加权提出了风险增强型行为信息目标，得到了可解释的、覆盖从保守到激进区间的信息-风险价值评估族。理论层面我们证明，价值评估参数可在高信息/高风险路径和低信息/低风险路径之间生成切换边界，在可行探索策略上诱导出变换后的帕累托前沿结构。大规模失效截断网格世界实验表明，仅调整价值评估规则就可以重塑信息-风险前沿：香农信息规划是优秀的原始信息基线，而风险感知目标可以通过规避会中断后续感知的失效场景，降低机器人的危险暴露度和损失率。风险增强型行为价值评估与标准风险感知基线相比具备帕累托竞争力，可提供可解释的保守和中间决策区间。研究结果表明，机器人不仅需要推理动作能降低多少不确定性，还需要判断该不确定性降低的收益是否值得承担获取它所需的风险。

title: GPU-CFR: 80x Faster Counterfactual Regret Minimization by Compiling the Game to Static Dataflow and CUDA Graph Replay
title_zh: GPU-CFR：通过将游戏编译为静态数据流与CUDA图重放实现80倍速的反事实遗憾最小化
authors: Boning Li, Longbo Huang
abstract: Counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) is one of the few large numerical workloads that still runs faster on CPUs than on GPUs. Each iteration sweeps a game tree with up to billions of states in millions of small, interdependent gather and scatter steps issued through a generic tree interface. On a GPU every kernel finishes in microseconds, so kernel launches and framework dispatch dominate the run time, and prior GPU implementations have lost to optimized CPU code. We observe that for a fixed game, everything about a CFR iteration except the numerical values is known before the first iteration runs. We propose GPU-CFR, a compiler and runtime built on this observation. It compiles any game once into static dataflow: flat edge and information-set arrays, precomputed indices, and depth-level batched passes fix the entire operation sequence, and only solver state changes between iterations. Static chance folding, depth-level execution blocks, and a dual-lane reach buffer cut the number of framework operations by up to 18.1x. Because shapes, indices, and buffer addresses never change, CUDA Graph Replay records the iteration once and replays it with a single graph launch. On one A100, across an eight-game suite that spans card games, dice games, and board games, GPU-CFR runs 29.8--80.4x faster than the fastest prior GPU CFR on the same accelerator, and 14--258x faster than LiteEFG, one of the fastest open-source CPU implementations, on the four largest games. The compiled representation carries most of that margin: on eight CPU threads with no accelerator it is already 2.2--51.1x faster than the GPU baseline. On the CPU the optimized path reproduces the reference iterates bitwise, and tree construction and graph capture pay for themselves within the first solve. GPU-CFR beats every CPU and GPU baseline on the mid-to-large games of the suite without changing the update rule.
summary_zh: 反事实遗憾最小化（Counterfactual Regret Minimization, CFR）是少数几个在CPU上运行速度仍快于GPU的大规模数值工作负载之一。CFR的每一轮迭代都要遍历包含数十亿状态的游戏树，通过通用树接口执行数百万个相互依赖的小粒度收集和散射操作。在GPU上每个内核的运行时间仅为微秒级，因此内核启动和框架调度开销占据了绝大部分运行时间，现有GPU实现的性能始终不及优化后的CPU代码。我们观察到，对于固定游戏，除了数值变量之外，CFR迭代的所有信息都可以在第一次迭代运行前预先确定。基于该发现本文提出GPU-CFR，一个配套编译器和运行时的优化框架。它将任意游戏一次性编译为静态数据流：扁平化边数组和信息集数组、预计算索引、深度层级批量处理可固定全部操作序列，迭代过程中仅求解器状态发生变化。静态机会折叠、深度层级执行块、双路可达缓冲区最多可将框架操作数量降低18.1倍。由于张量形状、索引、缓冲区地址全程不变，CUDA图重放机制仅需记录一次迭代流程，后续通过单次图启动即可完成重放。在单张A100显卡上，针对覆盖卡牌游戏、骰子游戏、桌面游戏的8款测试集，GPU-CFR的运行速度比同硬件上最快的现有GPU CFR实现快29.8~80.4倍，在4款最大规模游戏上比最快的开源CPU实现LiteEFG快14~258倍。编译表示带来了绝大部分性能优势：即使在无加速卡的8线程CPU上，其运行速度也比GPU基线快2.2~51.1倍。在CPU上优化路径的迭代结果与参考结果逐比特一致，树构建和图捕获的开销在第一次求解过程中就可被抵消。在不修改更新规则的前提下，GPU-CFR在测试集的中大型游戏上性能超过了所有CPU和GPU基线方法。

title: General Quantification of Covariate and Concept Shifts
authors: Hongbo Chen, Li Charlie Xia
abstract: Generalization under distribution shift remains a core challenge in modern machine learning, yet existing learning bound theory is limited to narrow, idealized settings and is non-estimable from samples. In this paper, we bridge the gap between theory and practical applications. We first show that existing definition of concept shift breaks when the source and target supports mismatch. Leveraging entropic optimal transport, we propose a key notion: $\gamma^{*}\!$-concept shifts, and derive a general error bound unifying covariate and $\gamma^{*}\!$-concept shifts, which applies to broad loss functions, label spaces, and stochastic labeling. We further develop estimators for these shifts with concentration guarantees, and the DataShifts algorithm, which can quantify distribution shifts and estimate the error bound in most applications - a rigorous and general tool for analyzing learning error under distribution shift.

title: Can Edge-Deployable Vision-Language Models Identify Species?
title_zh: 可部署于边缘端的视觉语言模型能否识别物种？
authors: William Zhou, Mayukha Siripuram, Xiao Yan, Ziqi Liu, Yi Ding
abstract: Camera traps often run in the field on edge hardware with limited or no connectivity, making small, locally-deployable vision-language models (VLMs) -- not frontier-scale ones -- the practically relevant class to evaluate for species identification. We test whether models in this deployment-relevant 2--8B range carry genuine taxonomic knowledge, evaluating four such VLMs (Qwen3-VL 2B/4B/8B, Gemma3 4B) against the domain-specific specialist BioCLIP (300M parameters) on a 96-species task, comparing clean iNaturalist photographs against camera-trap imagery from 6this http URLcollections, on two independently-sampled evaluation sets. All models identify species far above chance, but every model -- general-purpose or specialist -- degrades sharply on field imagery (domain gaps of 9.6--26.6 percentage points, consistent across taxonomic levels and both evaluation sets), indicating the degradation reflects general image legibility rather than fine-grained discrimination failure. BioCLIP substantially outperforms every VLM tested (by 33.2--59.2 percentage points across an expanded 200-image sample for every model) despite its far smaller size, suggesting the gap reflects specialized training data rather than model scale; yet BioCLIP's own domain gap (18.0 points) is statistically indistinguishable from the best VLM's (22.3 points), suggesting the clean-to-field degradation itself is a property of the image-quality shift rather than a general-purpose-model weakness. Under open-set prompting, 5.9--9.6% of responses are syntactically valid but taxonomically nonexistent species names; the relative fabrication-rate ranking across models replicates exactly across both evaluation sets, a more robust finding than any single point estimate.
summary_zh: 红外相机通常部署在野外边缘硬件上，网络连接有限甚至完全无网络，因此适合本地部署的小型视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）而非前沿超大规模模型，才是物种识别场景下具备实际应用价值的评估对象。本研究测试了参数量在20亿~80亿区间、符合部署要求的模型是否具备真实的分类学知识，在包含96个物种的识别任务上对4款该量级的视觉语言模型（Qwen3-VL 2B/4B/8B、Gemma3 4B）与领域专用模型BioCLIP（参数量3亿）进行对比，测试集包含两类独立采样数据集，分别来自iNaturalist平台的清晰照片与6个公开数据集的红外相机影像。所有模型的物种识别准确率均远高于随机猜测水平，但无论是通用模型还是专用模型，在野外影像上的性能都出现大幅下降（领域差距达9.6~26.6个百分点，该结果在所有分类层级和两个测试集上均保持一致），表明性能下降的原因是野外影像的可读性普遍降低，而非细粒度判别能力失效。尽管参数量远小于测试的所有视觉语言模型，BioCLIP的表现仍大幅优于后者（在扩展后的200张图像样本上性能领先33.2~59.2个百分点），说明该性能差距来源于专用训练数据而非模型规模；但BioCLIP自身的领域差距（18.0个百分点）与最优视觉语言模型的领域差距（22.3个百分点）在统计上无显著差异，说明从清晰图像到野外图像的性能下降本质上是图像质量偏移导致的，并非通用模型的固有缺陷。在开放集提示设置下，5.9%~9.6%的模型输出是语法合法但分类学上不存在的虚构物种名；不同模型的虚构率排名在两个测试集上完全一致，该结论比任意单点估计结果都更具鲁棒性。

title: Generative Marketing Mix Modeling: A Causal Inference Framework Linking GEO and GEM to Business Impact
title_zh: 生成式营销组合建模：连接GEO与GEM对业务影响的因果推断框架
authors: Masahiro Kato, Daiki Honma, Taka Kato
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence changes how firms reach customers, but standard marketing data do not record how often users see and notice a firm's name in generated answers. We develop Generative Marketing Mix Modeling (GMMM) to estimate the causal effects of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Generative Engine Marketing (GEM). For GEO, GMMM combines repeated generated answers with question counts, shares of use across generative systems, and notice probabilities. For GEM, it combines records of sponsored placements with notice probabilities. GMMM compares expected business responses under alternative treatment sequences and establishes sufficient conditions for identifying the resulting effects. We investigate the empirical performance of the proposed method using simulated answers to product recommendation in English and Japanese.
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能改变了企业触达用户的方式，但传统营销数据无法记录用户在生成式回答中看到并注意到企业名称的频率。本研究提出生成式营销组合建模（Generative Marketing Mix Modeling, GMMM）框架，用于估计生成引擎优化（Generative Engine Optimization, GEO）与生成引擎营销（Generative Engine Marketing, GEM）的因果效应。针对GEO场景，GMMM将重复生成的回答、问题计数、生成系统的使用占比与用户注意力概率相结合；针对GEM场景，该框架将赞助投放记录与注意力概率相结合。GMMM可对比不同干预序列下的预期业务响应，为识别最终效应提供充分条件。本研究使用英文和日文的产品推荐模拟回答，验证了所提方法的实证性能。

title: Artificial Id: Drive and Persistent Alignment in Agentic AI
title_zh: 人工ID：智能体AI中的内驱力与持续对齐
authors: Yakov Pyotr Shkolnikov
abstract: Agentic AI is moving from bounded task execution toward systems that retain consequential state, continue operating and adapt across task boundaries. That shift creates a control problem that current harnesses largely solve by hand: objectives, retries, verification, stopping rules and other behavioral transitions are specified externally. We propose an artificial id, an adaptive internal drive for determining whether behavior should continue, stop or change. In a minimal virtual Petri-dish experiment, a controller too small to perform general-purpose reasoning and receiving no task-specific behavioral objective develops useful control through differential persistence. The same mechanism selects an unintended physical strategy when that behavior persists better and later replaces a learned sensor mapping when its environmental meaning changes. These results show that adaptive direction can emerge without being explicitly specified as a behavioral objective. The same persistence that makes such adaptive agency useful can also allow misalignment, corrupted state and unintended behavior to persist across task boundaries. A scalable artificial id would carry consequential state and adaptive drive across those boundaries, making alignment a property of the continuing agentic system rather than of a model response or single trajectory. Such systems require a persistent alignment boundary over trusted observations, consequence channels, persistent state, authority, identity, provenance and hard constraints.
summary_zh: 智能体人工智能（Agentic AI）正从有限任务执行系统向可保留关键状态、跨任务边界持续运行并自适应的系统演进。该演进带来了新的控制问题，现有管控方案大多依赖人工实现：目标设定、重试机制、验证逻辑、停止规则及其他行为转换规则均由外部指定。本研究提出人工ID概念，即一种用于判断行为是否应当继续、停止或变更的自适应内部驱动力。在极简虚拟培养皿实验中，一个规模小到无法执行通用推理、也未接收任何任务特定行为目标的控制器，通过差异化持久化机制形成了有效的自主控制。当某类行为具备更高的持久化优势时，同一机制会选择出非预期的物理策略；当环境语义发生变化时，该机制还会替换已学习的传感器映射。上述结果表明，自适应方向无需被显式指定为行为目标即可自发涌现。这类自适应智能体所依赖的持久化机制同样可能导致不对齐、状态损坏与非预期行为跨任务边界持续存在。可扩展的人工ID将携带关键状态与自适应驱动力跨任务边界运行，使对齐成为持续运行的智能体系统的固有属性，而非单次模型响应或单条轨迹的属性。这类系统需要在可信观测、后果链路、持久化状态、权限、身份、溯源信息与硬约束层面建立持续的对齐边界。

title: Domain-Specific Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
title_zh: 大语言模型的领域专属幻觉检测
authors: Varun Teja Chundru, Debasmita Biswas
abstract: Large language models generate fluent text that can contain unfaithful claims -- a phenomenon known as hallucination. We present a multi-signal detection pipeline combining fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 classification, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout uncertainty quantification, and temperature-scaled calibration for response-level hallucination detection. Evaluated on the HaluEval benchmark, our pipeline achieves F1=0.915 and AUROC=0.977 on general-domain tasks, with per-task F1 scores of 0.97 (QA), 0.96 (Summarization), and 0.82 (Dialogue). MC Dropout inference further improves accuracy to 93.2%. A context ablation study confirms the model performs genuine entailment reasoning rather than exploiting surface patterns, with summarization F1 dropping 24% when knowledge context is removed. Learning curve analysis reveals that 25% of training data captures 77% of full-data performance. Beyond detection, we apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to a Qwen2.5-0.5B generator, reducing its hallucination rate from 85.5% to 37.7% (55.9% relative reduction) as measured by our detector. Cross-domain evaluation on the SciFact biomedical benchmark shows that general-domain training transfers poorly (F1=0.52), motivating domain-specific fine-tuning. PubMedBERT fine-tuned on SciFact achieves F1=0.63 and AUROC=0.81, demonstrating that domain-matched pre-training is the strongest adaptation strategy. Code and models are available atthis https URL
summary_zh: 大语言模型生成的文本流畅度高，但可能包含不符合事实的错误陈述，该现象被称为幻觉。本研究提出一种多信号检测流水线，结合经过微调的DeBERTa-v3分类器、蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo, MC）Dropout不确定性量化方法与温度缩放校准技术，实现响应级别的幻觉检测。在HaluEval基准上测试时，该流水线在通用领域任务上的F1值达0.915，AUROC值达0.977，各子任务的F1值分别为：问答任务0.97、摘要任务0.96、对话任务0.82。引入MC Dropout推理可进一步将准确率提升至93.2%。上下文消融实验证实，模型执行的是真正的蕴涵推理而非利用表面模式，移除知识上下文后摘要任务的F1值下降24%。学习曲线分析显示，仅使用25%的训练数据即可达到全量数据77%的性能。除检测任务外，本研究将直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization, DPO）应用于Qwen2.5-0.5B生成器，经本研究提出的检测器测算，其幻觉率从85.5%降至37.7%，相对降幅达55.9%。在SciFact生物医学基准上的跨领域评估显示，通用领域训练的泛化效果较差（F1值仅为0.52），说明开展领域专属微调十分必要。在SciFact数据集上微调的PubMedBERT模型F1值达0.63，AUROC值达0.81，证实与领域匹配的预训练是最优的适配策略。相关代码与模型已公开在对应链接中。

title: Biology-in-the-loop: Amortized Adaptive Hit Discovery in CRISPR Screens
authors: Carl Edwards, Edward De Brouwer, Xiner Li, Namkyeong Lee, Ehsan Hajiramezanali 等 (8 人)
abstract: Many biological discovery problems require experiments to be selected sequentially under constrained budgets. CRISPR screening is a prominent example, as exhaustive perturbation testing is often infeasible and candidate perturbations must instead be prioritized over multiple experimental rounds. Despite the importance of this problem, existing benchmarks for adaptive hit discovery remain limited in scale and diversity. Here, we introduce AssayBench-Loop, a large-scale benchmark for adaptive hit discovery comprising 1,389 CRISPR screens across five phenotype categories. Beyond enabling systematic evaluation, its scale makes it possible to learn acquisition strategies across historical experiments. Building on this resource, we introduce AssayLoop, a sequential experimental design framework combining AssayFormer, a transformer-based amortized acquisition policy trained across historical screens to adapt from experimental feedback, with LLM-derived biological priors through an adaptive handoff. In this view, completed experiments become training data for learning how accumulated evidence should guide what to test next, while LLMs provide prior biological knowledge to seed the search. We further introduce AssayLLM, showing that the same principle can be extended directly to an LLM through task-specific post-training. On temporally held-out screens, AssayLoop achieves a 5.67-fold enrichment over random selection and recovers 27.7% of hits after assaying approximately 5% of the candidate library, outperforming existing adaptive-design methods and standalone LLMs, and AssayFormer alone. Performance improves with increasing historical training data and transfers to phenotype categories excluded from training. These results demonstrate the value of learning acquisition policies across historical experiments and combining them with broad biological priors for efficient adaptive hit discovery.

title: On the Regularization Landscape for the Linear Recommendation Models
title_zh: 线性推荐模型的正则化景观研究
authors: Dong Li, Zhenming Liu, Ruoming Jin, Hao Zhou, Zhi Liu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Recently, a wide range of recommendation algorithms inspired by deep learning techniques have emerged as the performance leaders on several standard recommendation benchmarks. While these algorithms were built on different DL techniques (e.g., dropouts, autoencoder), they have similar performance and even similar cost functions. This paper studies whether the models' comparable performance are sheer coincidence, or they can be unified under a single framework. We find that all linear performance leaders effectively add only a nuclear-norm based regularizer, or a Frobenius-norm based regularizer. The former ones possess a (surprising) rigid structure that limits the models' predictive power but their solutions are low rank and have closed form. The latter ones are more expressive and more efficient for recommendation but their solutions are either full-rank or require executing hard-to-tune numeric procedures such as ADMM. Along this line of finding, we further propose two low-rank, closed-form solutions, derived from carefully generalizing Frobenius-norm based regularizers. The new solutions get the best of both nuclear-norm and Frobenius-norm world.
summary_zh: 近年来，大量借鉴深度学习技术的推荐算法在多个标准推荐基准上取得了领先性能。尽管这些算法基于不同的深度学习技术（如丢弃法、自编码器），但性能相近，甚至损失函数也高度相似。本文研究了这类模型性能相近是纯粹的巧合，还是可以被统一到同一个框架下。研究发现，所有性能领先的线性推荐模型本质上都仅添加了基于核范数（nuclear-norm）的正则器，或是基于弗罗贝尼乌斯范数（Frobenius-norm）的正则器。前者具备严格的固定结构，会限制模型的预测能力，但得到的解是低秩的且存在闭式解；后者的表达能力更强，在推荐场景下的运行效率更高，但得到的解要么是满秩的，要么需要执行难以调参的数值流程（如交替方向乘子法ADMM）。基于该发现，本文进一步提出了两个低秩、带闭式解的方案，通过对弗罗贝尼乌斯范数正则器进行严谨的泛化得到，兼顾了核范数正则器与弗罗贝尼乌斯范数正则器的优势。

title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
title_zh: 人类打造的最后一代AI：迈向真正的递归自改进
authors: Yi Duan, Ying Liu, Zirui Tang, Haodong Chen, Jun Zhou 等 (33 人)
abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables AI systems to turn experience and feedback into persistent changes that improve both their capabilities and the process of future improvement. We first use the Headroom-Closed Index (HCI) to reveal the problems of existing LLMs, then introduce the RSI concept and its development roadmap: from improvement-execution autonomy, improvement-strategy autonomy, experience-acquisition autonomy, and environment-adaptation autonomy, to recursive meta-improvement. Next we examine RSI across scenarios (e.g., scientific discovery, embodied intelligence, software engineering), highlighting their distinct requirements and development speeds. Drawing on diverse industry practices and preliminary empirical evidence, we connect RSI research with practical systems and identify key challenges to achieving genuine RSI.
summary_zh: 递归自改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）可使AI系统将经验与反馈转化为持续的能力提升，同时优化未来的改进流程。本文首先使用余量闭合指数（Headroom-Closed Index, HCI）揭示现有大语言模型存在的问题，随后介绍RSI的概念与发展路线图：从改进执行自主、改进策略自主、经验获取自主、环境适配自主，逐步演进到递归元改进。之后本文在科学发现、具身智能、软件工程等多个场景下对RSI展开分析，明确不同场景的差异化需求与发展速度。结合产业界的多元实践与初步实证结果，本文将RSI研究与实际系统相结合，梳理出实现真正RSI需要突破的核心挑战。

title: RetroThinker: Enabling Retrospective Thinking in Speech LLMs
title_zh: RetroThinker：为语音大语言模型赋能回溯思考能力
authors: Yi-Jen Shih, Puyuan Peng, Abdelrahman Mohamed, David Harwath
abstract: Speech large language models (SpeechLLMs) offer reduced latency and retain paralinguistic nuances that are typically lost in cascaded automatic speech recognition (ASR) and text-based LM architectures. However, they continue to lag behind text-only LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, while real-time spoken interaction imposes strict latency constraints. Although prior works employ Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and concurrent reasoning to enhance reasoning capabilities without inducing prohibitive delays, an inherent accuracy-latency trade-off persists. In this paper, we investigate whether a streaming SpeechLLM can dynamically revise its reasoning traces on the fly. We introduce RetroThinker, a multi-stage post-training framework that equips the Moshi model to self-verify and forward-correct CoT steps during inference. RetroThinker combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated retrospective thinking data with length-based direct preference optimization (DPO) to optimize retrospective during early reasoning (i.e., reasoning concurrently while the user speaks). Evaluated on the GSM8K benchmark, RetroThinker significantly improves the accuracy-latency trade-off over non-retrospective baselines, achieving an 11% absolute accuracy gain at a comparable latency.
summary_zh: 语音大语言模型（Speech Large Language Models, SpeechLLMs）不仅可降低推理延迟，还能保留传统串联式自动语音识别（Automatic Speech Recognition, ASR）+文本大语言模型架构通常会丢失的副语言细节。但在复杂推理任务上，语音大语言模型的表现仍落后于纯文本大语言模型，同时实时语音交互对延迟有严格要求。现有研究通过引入思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）与并行推理机制提升推理能力，同时避免延迟过高，但准确率与延迟之间仍存在固有 trade-off。本文探究流式语音大语言模型能否动态地实时修正自身的推理轨迹，提出RetroThinker——一个多阶段后训练框架，可使Moshi模型在推理过程中自主验证并正向修正思维链步骤。RetroThinker结合了在精心构建的回溯思考数据集上的监督微调（SFT）与基于长度的直接偏好优化（DPO），可在推理早期（即用户说话的同时并行开展推理）优化回溯行为。在GSM8K基准上的测试结果显示，相较于不具备回溯能力的基线模型，RetroThinker大幅优化了准确率-延迟权衡关系，在延迟相当的情况下实现了11%的绝对准确率提升。

title: Explainability Assistant: A Conversational XAI Interface for Interpreting Energy Consumption Models
title_zh: 可解释性助手：用于解读能耗模型的对话式可解释人工智能界面
authors: Rodion Krjutškov, Eduard Barbu, Nikos Sakkas, Sofia Yfanti
abstract: Energy consumption forecasting relies on increasingly complex machine learning (ML) models, such as Genetic Programming-based symbolic regressors, whose predictions can be difficult for facility managers and building operators to interpret. Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques address this opacity, but traditional XAI dashboards require substantial technical expertise and provide limited flexibility for dynamic, context-aware inquiry. Conversational XAI systems offer a promising alternative; however, previous approaches, such as TalkToModel, were constrained by rigid custom grammars and achieved only 76.8% intent-parsing accuracy. This paper introduces the Explainability Assistant, an open-source conversational XAI system that leverages the function-calling capabilities of modern Large Language Models (LLMs) to overcome these limitations. The system achieves 94% intent-parsing accuracy, supports flexible natural language interaction, and adapts to different ML problem types without task-specific fine-tuning. We present the system's architecture and report results from a comparative evaluation conducted with energy domain specialists, contrasting the Explainability Assistant with a traditional XAI dashboard. The evaluation suggests improved usability and consistent task accuracy, with all experts unanimously preferring the conversational interface for practical use.
summary_zh: 能耗预测领域越来越多地采用复杂机器学习模型，例如基于遗传编程的符号回归器，这类模型的预测结果难以被设施管理者与楼宇运营者解读。可解释人工智能（Explainable Artificial Intelligence, XAI）技术可解决这类黑箱问题，但传统XAI仪表盘要求使用者具备较高的技术专业度，且无法灵活支持动态的、上下文感知的查询。对话式XAI系统是极具潜力的替代方案，但此前的相关方案（如TalkToModel）受限于刚性的自定义语法，意图解析准确率仅为76.8%。本文提出可解释性助手，这是一款开源对话式XAI系统，利用现代大语言模型的函数调用能力突破了上述局限。该系统的意图解析准确率达94%，支持灵活的自然语言交互，无需针对特定任务微调即可适配不同类型的机器学习问题。本文介绍了该系统的架构，并展示了与能源领域专家共同开展的对比评估结果，将可解释性助手与传统XAI仪表盘进行对比。评估结果表明，该系统的可用性显著提升，任务准确率稳定，所有专家均一致表示在实际场景中更偏好使用该对话式界面。

title: From Parameters to Answers: How LLMs Retrieve and Use Their Internal Knowledge
title_zh: 从参数到答案：大语言模型如何检索与运用其内部知识
authors: Wenkang Wei, Yuan Fang, Renhe Jiang, Hong Cheng, Xingtong Yu
abstract: How does a language model's dependence on query-routing information and target knowledge change as it answers a question? We study this question through layerwise interventions on the hidden state at the end of the question. Across Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, we compare country-continent questions with noun, adjective, and code answers while keeping several fitted measurements distinct. A pair-conditioned request direction describes which country is queried in natural single-country questions; a global request direction describes first- versus second-country requests in paired questions; separate selection candidates test control among contents already available in the hidden state. A diagnostic reanalysis of frozen Qwen natural-question states shows that the pair-conditioned direction grows stronger before interventions on it begin to alter later fitted knowledge, with this causal window opening while answer-supporting content is still forming. The paired three-model trajectories are not uniform: Gemma shows a partially overlapping mid-layer routing-content profile, whereas Llama has no sustained routing-effect window under the same gates. In the paired protocol, dependence on the global request direction decreases from fixed earlier to later layer sets while dependence on fitted content persists. A matched Qwen comparison shows that the pair-conditioned direction retains a late effect, so this operational handoff concerns the global fitted direction rather than all request information. These results separate early readability, natural strength, causal steering, and later content dependence.
summary_zh: 语言模型在回答问题的过程中，对查询路由信息与目标知识的依赖关系会发生怎样的变化？本文通过在问题末尾的隐藏状态上执行逐层干预，对该问题展开研究。在Qwen、Llama与Gemma三款模型上，本文对比了答案类型为名词、形容词、编码的国家-大洲类问题，同时区分了多组拟合测量值。其中，配对条件请求方向描述了单国家自然问题中查询的具体国家；全局请求方向描述了配对问题中对第一个国家与第二个国家的请求差异；独立选择候选集用于测试隐藏状态中已有内容的控制机制。对冻结状态下Qwen处理自然问题的诊断性重分析显示，在针对配对条件方向的干预开始改变后续拟合知识之前，配对条件方向的强度会持续提升，该因果窗口在支撑答案的内容仍处于生成阶段时就已开启。三款模型的配对轨迹并不一致：Gemma在中间层呈现出路由与内容部分重叠的特征，而Llama在相同的门控机制下不存在持续的路由效应窗口。在配对实验设置中，模型对全局请求方向的依赖从底层到高层逐层递减，而对拟合内容的依赖始终保持稳定。针对Qwen的对照实验显示，配对条件方向在高层仍存在效应，说明该操作层面的交接过程针对的是全局拟合方向，而非所有请求信息。上述研究结果将早期可读性、自然强度、因果引导与后期内容依赖四类机制明确区分开来。

title: Model-Aware Schedules Improve Generation via Fiberwise Optimal Transport
title_zh: 基于模型感知调度的逐纤维最优传输生成性能提升
authors: Luyi Jia, Boyan Zhang, Yilun Liu, Steffen Rulands
abstract: Diffusion and flow-matching schedules control the signal and noise coefficients that mix data and noise along affine probability paths. Minimizing a kinetic action defined on coefficient paths, motivated by optimal transport, helps explain strong baselines but remains model-agnostic and ignores prediction error. Here we introduce a model-aware schedule construction based on fiberwise optimal transport. At a fixed time and state on the probability path, compatible signal/noise decompositions form an affine fiber. We define a fiberwise prediction risk by averaging optimal-transport costs between the true and predictor-induced decompositions within these fibers. On a fixed coefficient curve, combining this risk with coefficient-path kinetic action yields a closed-form optimal time allocation. This construction extends to general linear prediction targets, and the risk profile can be estimated from an early baseline checkpoint. We evaluate DDPMs and flow matching across prediction targets, training configurations, risk-estimation checkpoints, datasets, and architectures. Our model-aware schedules consistently outperform strong baselines, including a 38.6% relative FID reduction for flow matching on CIFAR-10 at 16 function evaluations. Each model-agnostic kinetic baseline determines its own kinetic reference coordinate. In these coordinates, fiberwise-risk profiles from independently trained models in different settings align closely after normalization to unit area. The resulting schedule deformations used in training also align, suggesting empirical universality across the evaluated models and settings. Pretrained-checkpoint diagnostics extend this normalized-risk agreement to larger conditional latent diffusion and 2-RF models. A frozen analytic allocation template retains most of the model-aware improvement without further risk estimation or model-specific fitting.
summary_zh: 扩散与流匹配调度控制沿仿射概率路径混合数据与噪声的信号系数和噪声系数。由最优传输理论驱动、定义在系数路径上的动力学作用最小化方法可以解释现有强基线的性能表现，但该方法属于模型无关方法，完全忽略了预测误差。本文提出了一种基于逐纤维最优传输的模型感知调度构建方法：在概率路径上的固定时间与状态下，所有兼容的信号/噪声分解构成一个仿射纤维。我们通过计算这些纤维内真实分解与预测器诱导分解之间的最优传输成本的平均值，定义了逐纤维预测风险。在固定系数曲线上，将该风险与系数路径动力学作用结合可得到闭式最优时间分配方案。该构建方法可扩展至通用线性预测目标，且风险分布可通过早期基线检查点估计得到。我们在不同预测目标、训练配置、风险估计检查点、数据集与模型架构下对DDPMs（去噪扩散概率模型）与流匹配方法开展了全面评估，结果表明本文提出的模型感知调度性能始终优于现有强基线，其中在16次函数评估条件下CIFAR-10数据集上流匹配方法的FID（弗雷歇 inception 距离）相对降低了38.6%。所有模型无关动力学基线都定义了自身的动力学参考坐标，在该坐标下，不同设置下独立训练的模型的逐纤维风险分布经归一化到单位面积后高度对齐，训练过程中使用的调度变形也保持一致，证明了所评估模型与设置下的经验普适性。预训练检查点诊断进一步将该归一化风险一致性扩展到更大规模的条件隐式扩散模型与2-RF模型。最终得到的冻结解析分配模板无需额外风险估计或模型特定拟合，即可保留绝大多数模型感知调度带来的性能提升。

title: Understanding Operator Attitudes Toward AI-Supported Decision Making in Maritime Operations
title_zh: 理解海事作业场景下操作人员对人工智能辅助决策的态度
authors: Doreen Jirak, Armeen Saroukanoff, Dirk van Rooy
abstract: Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) and AI- supported decision assistants are expected to transform maritime operations, but their safe integration depends on how maritime professionals perceive and trust such systems. This paper presents a survey study on maritime stakeholders' attitudes toward an AI-supported assistant in collision-avoidance scenarios. Participants evaluated technology anxiety, trust in automation, and explanation quality using established and adapted questionnaires, complemented by sentiment and thematic analysis of open-ended responses Results indicate a generally positive disposition toward maritime technology, no clear age-related differences in openness, stable trust across scenarios, and more scenario-sensitive, multidimensional explanation ratings. Open responses showed that participants valued support for decision-making, situation awareness, and confidence-building, while raising concerns about AI reliability, over- reliance and loss of expertise. The findings suggest that maritime AI systems should not focus solely on increasing automation or trust, but on supporting calibrated reliance through transparent, reliable, and operationally meaningful design with domain experts in the loop.
summary_zh: MASS（自主水面船舶）与人工智能辅助决策助手有望彻底变革海事作业模式，但二者的安全落地集成高度依赖海事从业者对这类系统的感知与信任程度。本文针对海事利益相关者在避碰场景下对AI辅助助手的态度开展了问卷调查研究：参与者通过成熟量表与适配后的问卷对技术焦虑、自动化信任度与解释质量进行评分，同时结合开放式回答的情感分析与主题分析补充研究结论。结果显示：受访者对海事技术整体持积极态度，技术开放度不存在显著的年龄相关差异，不同场景下的信任度保持稳定，而解释质量评分则呈现出多维度、场景敏感的特征。开放式回答分析表明，受访者普遍认可AI系统对决策支持、态势感知与信心构建的正向作用，同时也对AI可靠性、过度依赖问题与专业能力退化风险表达了担忧。上述发现说明海事AI系统的设计不能仅聚焦于提升自动化程度或用户信任度，而应当通过透明、可靠、符合作业实际需求的设计，结合领域专家全程参与的机制，实现用户对系统的适度依赖。

title: Thinking with Looped Flows
title_zh: 基于循环流的深度推理机制
authors: Ayhan Suleymanzade, Chanhyuk Lee, Floor Eijkelboom, Nicholas M. Boffi, İsmail İlkan Ceylan 等 (6 人)
abstract: Humans and machines often solve harder problems by spending more time on computation. In deep learning, looped models implement this idea during inference by recurrently updating a hidden state. In practice, however, their training backpropagates through only one or a few updates, making it hard to train early updates to support future ones. We propose looped flows, an approach that sidesteps this issue by training the recurrence with local denoising objectives. By imposing temporal association across denoising objectives through progressively decreasing noise levels and shared noise, the model is incentivized to learn recurrent states that transfer useful computation over time, even when gradients cover only a few updates. We then formulate inference as integrating the velocity of a probability flow parameterized by the learned denoiser, coupled with recurrent states. This allows solving harder problems by spending more computation through a finer temporal grid and enables multiple valid predictions from different initial noise samples. Across six reasoning benchmarks including two multi-solution benchmarks, looped flows outperform prior state-of-the-art looped models overall, achieving 58.8% test accuracy on ARC-AGI-1 and 12.2% on ARC-AGI-2.
summary_zh: 人类与机器通常会通过投入更多计算资源来解决更复杂的问题。深度学习领域的循环模型在推理阶段通过循环更新隐状态实现这一思路，但在实际训练过程中，循环模型的反向传播仅覆盖一次或少数几次更新，导致很难让早期更新为后续更新提供支撑。本文提出了循环流（looped flows）方法，通过局部去噪目标训练循环结构，规避了上述问题。该方法通过逐步降低噪声水平与共享噪声，在不同去噪目标之间施加时间关联约束，即使梯度仅覆盖少数几次更新，也能引导模型学习到可随时间传递有效计算的循环状态。随后我们将推理过程建模为对由学习得到的去噪器参数化的概率流速度的积分，该概率流与循环状态耦合，可通过更精细的时间网格投入更多计算资源求解更复杂的问题，同时支持从不同初始噪声采样得到多个有效预测结果。在包含两个多解基准的六个推理基准测试集上，循环流的整体性能优于现有最先进的循环模型，在ARC-AGI-1数据集上达到58.8%的测试准确率，在ARC-AGI-2数据集上达到12.2%的测试准确率。

title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Switch Aware Evaluation of ASR and Audio Language Models on English Yoruba Code-Switched Speech
title_zh: 超越词错误率：英语-约鲁巴语代码切换语音下自动语音识别与音频语言模型的语种切换感知评估
authors: Chibuzor Okocha, Christan Earl Grant
abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems and audio language models (audio LMs) now report low error rates on monolingual benchmarks, but their behavior on code switched speech in low resource, diacritic rich languages remains poorly characterized. We present a switch aware evaluation of eleven modern systems (six ASR models and five audio LMs) on English Yoruba code-switched speech, using a deterministic 2000 utterance evaluation set and a shared scoring pipeline. Beyond word error rate (WER), we report switch localized diagnostics: a switch entry token error rate (SETER), windowed switch point error rates, language specific error rates, and a diacritic insensitive WER. Our central finding is that aggregate WER hides code switching behavior. The best system by WER (an ASR model) is statistically indistinguishable from a leading audio LM on WER, yet the audio LM is significantly better on every switch localized metric. Across faithful systems, Yoruba token recognition collapses (error 0.97 for almost all systems) while English tokens are recognized far better, and errors concentrate sharply at switches into Yoruba. Several generative audio LMs fail as exact transcribers, producing translation, verbosity, and prompt leakage that are strongly prompt dependent. We release manifests, metric implementations, and evaluation scripts to support reproducible, switch aware benchmarking for African code switched speech.
summary_zh: 当前ASR（自动语音识别）系统与音频语言模型（音频LMs）在单语言基准测试集上的错误率已经很低，但这类模型在低资源、多变音符号语言的代码切换语音上的表现仍缺乏系统性表征。本文针对英语-约鲁巴语代码切换语音，对11款主流系统（6个ASR模型与5个音频LM）开展了语种切换感知评估，使用包含2000条语音的确定性评估集与统一评分流水线。除WER（词错误率）外，本文还报告了多个面向语种切换的细粒度指标：切换入口令牌错误率（SETER）、滑动窗口切换点错误率、分语言错误率与不考虑变音符号的词错误率。核心研究发现为：聚合级别的词错误率会掩盖代码切换场景下的模型行为差异。词错误率最优的ASR模型与领先的音频LM在词错误率指标上没有统计层面的显著差异，但音频LM在所有面向语种切换的细粒度指标上的表现都显著更优。在所有忠实转录的系统中，约鲁巴语令牌识别性能几乎完全失效（绝大多数系统的错误率高达0.97），而英语令牌的识别效果好得多，错误高度集中在切换到约鲁巴语的节点处。部分生成式音频LM无法作为精确转录器使用，会生成翻译内容、冗余内容与提示泄露问题，且这类问题高度依赖提示设计。本文公开了评估清单、指标实现代码与评估脚本，为非洲语言代码切换语音的可复现语种切换感知基准测试提供支撑。

title: Recognizing Is Not Reversing: A Controlled Inversion Test of Fact-Preserving News Framing
title_zh: 识别不等于反转：事实保留型新闻框架的可控反转测试
authors: Yi Liu
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to analyze and rewrite news, yet current framing studies mainly evaluate generation, detection, or whether rewritten text appears more neutral. They do not directly show whether a model can undo a known framing transformation while keeping the facts fixed. We introduce a controlled inversion test over three established textual realizations of framing: evaluative lexis, agency realization, and information salience. Across 60 news articles and three intervention strengths, this yields 540 paired variants with preserved atomic facts and recorded edits. Across Qwen, DeepSeek, and Kimi, factual preservation remains near 0.84, whereas intervention reversal is 0.044--0.068. Even when both framing type and direction are recognized correctly, pooled reversal reaches 0.071. These results reveal a clear separation between factual fidelity, framing recognition, and framing inversion: recognizing how an article is framed does not imply that the framing can be undone.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于新闻内容分析与改写，但现有框架相关研究主要聚焦于生成效果评估、检测任务，或改写后文本的中立性程度，并未直接验证模型能否在完全保留事实的前提下，撤销已知的新闻框架变换。本文针对三类成熟的新闻框架文本实现方式——评价性词汇选择、施事关系实现与信息凸显度设置，设计了一套可控反转测试。在60篇新闻文章、三种干预强度的设置下，共生成540对保留原子事实且记录了编辑操作的变体文本。在Qwen、DeepSeek与Kimi三个主流大模型上的测试结果显示，事实保留率稳定在0.84左右，但框架反转率仅为0.044~0.068。即使模型正确识别出框架类型与方向，整体反转率也仅为0.071。上述结果清晰证明了事实保真度、框架识别能力与框架反转能力三者之间存在明确的能力断层：能够识别文章的框架特征，并不代表模型可以撤销该框架变换。

title: A Unified Per-Token Gating Family for On-Policy Distillation: FKL/RKL Mixing with Multi-Channel and Bias Coefficients
title_zh: 面向在线策略蒸馏的统一逐令牌门控族：融合多通道与偏置系数的FKL/RKL混合机制
authors: Suwan Wu, Yumeng Lin, Pengcheng Yuan, Xiaolong Jiang
abstract: Per-token gating of forward/reverse KL losses has become a standard technique for on-policy knowledge distillation (OPD), but existing methods such as EOPD (Jin et al., 2026) and ToDi (Jung et al., 2025) each fix a single gating signal and a single gating direction, and the two have never been compared directly. We introduce a four-coefficient parameterization lambda_t = sigma(a * h_t + b * u(x) + c + d * gap_t) in which direction-aligned proxies of EOPD and ToDi appear as one-dimensional (1D) restrictions, and which adds multi-channel composition and an explicit bias as further degrees of freedom. On TweetEval (Barbieri et al., 2020) emotion and hate, with a Qwen3-32B teacher and a Qwen3-4B student, configurations in the full family reach higher accuracy than the matched-magnitude single-channel (entropy-only / gap-only) 1D restrictions in 33 of 36 comparable cells, and a 26-cell mean-match isolation experiment places dynamic gating ahead of effective-KL-matched static baselines in 19 of 26 cells. Because cells share training data, models, and parameter substructure, we report both counts as exploratory aggregate directional evidence rather than as independent hypothesis tests. Targeted three-seed paired replications of the nine headline comparisons singled out by that sweep -- including a third task, offensive -- are directionally consistent, but individually smaller than the single-seed estimates and not significant at n=3. We therefore present the parameterization primarily as a shared coordinate system for comparing per-token gating designs in short-output classification OPD.
summary_zh: 前向/反向KL散度的逐令牌门控机制已经成为在线策略知识蒸馏（OPD）的标准技术，但现有方法如EOPD（Jin等人，2026）与ToDi（Jung等人，2025）都仅固定单一门控信号与单一门控方向，二者从未被直接对比。本文提出了一种四系数参数化形式λ_t = σ(a * h_t + b * u(x) + c + d * gap_t)，其中EOPD与ToDi的方向对齐代理都可视为该参数化的一维限制形式，同时新增了多通道组合与显式偏置作为额外自由度。在TweetEval（Barbieri等人，2020）数据集的情感分类与仇恨言论分类任务上，使用Qwen3-32B作为教师模型、Qwen3-4B作为学生模型的实验结果表明，完整参数族中的配置在36个可比实验组的33个中，准确率都高于同等量级的单通道（仅熵/仅间隙）一维限制基线；26组均值匹配隔离实验中，动态门控在26个实验组的19个中性能优于匹配有效KL的静态基线。由于所有实验组共享训练数据、模型与参数子结构，本文将上述统计结果作为探索性的聚合方向性证据，而非独立假设检验结果。针对上述遍历筛选出的9组核心对比（新增冒犯言论分类任务）开展的三种子种子重复实验结果与上述方向一致，但单组结果的效应量小于单种子估计结果，在n=3的设置下未达到统计显著性。因此本文提出的参数化形式主要作为一套统一坐标系统，用于对比短输出分类在线策略蒸馏场景下的各类逐令牌门控设计。

title: SIRF: A Spec-Internalized Risk Foundation Model for Industrial Content Risk Control
title_zh: SIRF：面向工业内容风险管控的规范内化风险基础模型
authors: Suwan Wu, Yumeng Lin, Pengcheng Yuan, Xiaolong Jiang
abstract: For industrial content risk control, the real deployment constraint is not average accuracy but how much risk can be auto-handled under high precision and second-level latency. We present SIRF (Spec-Internalized Risk Foundation Model), which internalizes a platform's complex policies, synthesized without additional human annotation via EntiGraph, MAGA rewriting and account-level chain-of-thought (CoT), into the weights via continued pretraining (CPT), so rules are applied at high precision under an ultra-low-latency, verdict-only deployment. A controlled same-source comparison (Qwen3-8B-SFT vs. SIRF-8B-SFT, identical policy injection and verdict-only output form, differing only in policy-grounded CPT) attributes the gain to internalization: SIRF-8B-SFT reaches 71.3% Black Recall@P95, +15.1pp over the baseline, using only ~70M CPT tokens without harming general ability, and among included, logprob-available models under this interface it matches or exceeds far larger systems. SIRF is deployed as a tree-model adjudication layer (20% more mis-penalized samples recovered) and transfers to a freezing scenario at low cost (~70% relative mis-penalization reduction).
summary_zh: 工业内容风险管控的实际部署约束并非平均准确率，而是在高精度、秒级延迟条件下可自动处理的风险占比。本文提出SIRF（Spec-Internalized Risk Foundation Model，规范内化风险基础模型），该方法通过EntiGraph、MAGA改写与账户级思维链（CoT）技术，无需额外人工标注即可合成平台复杂管控规则，随后通过持续预训练（CPT）将规则内化到模型权重中，最终可在仅输出判定结果的超低延迟部署模式下实现规则的高精度应用。同源对照实验（Qwen3-8B-SFT与SIRF-8B-SFT对比，二者规则注入方式、仅输出判定结果的形式完全一致，仅是否经过规则导向持续预训练存在差异）证明性能提升完全来自规则内化机制：仅使用约7000万持续预训练令牌的SIRF-8B-SFT在P95精度下的黑样本召回率达到71.3%，相比基线提升15.1个百分点，且不会损害模型通用能力，在该部署接口下所有支持对数概率输出的模型中，其性能与参数量大得多的系统持平甚至更优。目前SIRF已部署为树模型裁决层，可多恢复20%的误判样本，且可低成本迁移到冻结部署场景，实现误判占比相对降低约70%。

title: LOCUS: Task-Aware Low-Rank Post-Training for Token-Efficient Language Generation
title_zh: LOCUS：面向令牌高效语言生成的任务感知低秩后训练方法
authors: Dongfang Zhao
abstract: Large language model serving costs scale directly with output sequence length, yet standard preference alignment often inflates response verbosity without improving utility. We study whether the parameterization of post-training updates affects generation length: low-rank subspaces alter sequence length without modifying the alignment loss. We present LOCUS, a method that selects a task-aware low-rank adaptation subspace to minimize output-token cost subject to a utility constraint. Within this subspace, post-training retains the native preference objective with a frozen backbone. Across Anthropic HH-RLHF dialogue preferences, we evaluate two $\sim$3B decoder backbones, Pythia-2.8B and Qwen2.5-3B, against protocol-matched full-parameter DPO and DrDPO branches and the released SamPO checkpoint. LOCUS reduces continuation length by up to 39.84\% on Pythia-2.8B and by 14.87--17.58\% on Qwen2.5-3B while updating only 0.24--0.28\% of model parameters, with no material change in the internal preference diagnostic.
summary_zh: 大语言模型的服务成本与输出序列长度直接正相关，但标准偏好对齐方法往往会增加回复的冗余度，却不会提升实际效用。本文研究后训练更新的参数化方式是否会影响生成长度：低秩子空间可以在不修改对齐损失的前提下改变序列生成长度。本文提出LOCUS方法，该方法选择任务感知的低秩适配子空间，在满足效用约束的前提下最小化输出令牌成本。在该子空间内，后训练过程在冻结骨干网络的前提下保留原生偏好优化目标。在Anthropic HH-RLHF对话偏好数据集上，我们对两个参数量约30亿的解码器骨干网络Pythia-2.8B与Qwen2.5-3B开展评估，对照基线包括协议完全匹配的全参数DPO、DrDPO分支与公开的SamPO检查点。实验结果表明，LOCUS仅更新0.24%~0.28%的模型参数，即可将Pythia-2.8B的回复续接长度最高降低39.84%，将Qwen2.5-3B的回复续接长度降低14.87%~17.58%，且内部偏好诊断指标未发生实质性变化。

title: Continuous-Time Acoustic Modelling with Neural Controlled Differential Equations
title_zh: 基于神经控制微分方程的连续时间声学建模
authors: Mattias Cross, Minghui Zhao, Anton Ragni
abstract: Text-to-speech (TTS) models commonly address text--speech alignment by expanding phone-level encoder states to frame-level decoder inputs using predicted durations. While this length-regulation step resolves alignment structurally, this use of duration typically changes only where and how often latent states appear, not the values of the states themselves. This paper proposes a continuous-time mechanism for duration-aware acoustic modelling in TTS using neural controlled differential equations (CDEs). We formulate the phone representation as a temporally parameterised control path and use a neural acoustic vector field to produce a continuous-time hidden state whose values evolve with phonetic content and duration-derived timing. The resulting trajectory can be sampled at discrete points and integrated into a standard acoustic decoder pipeline. Objective results contrast CDEs and typical recurrent models. Subjective results suggest that CDE-based models evaluating one phone per step can improve rank-order agreement between synthesised and reference emotion intensity while maintaining comparable emotion-expression quality to a strong baseline. Additional experiments with half-phone step-sizes suggest that temporal resolution changes the trade-off between style tracking and absolute calibration. These results position CDEs as a promising design space for continuous-time and duration-aware style-sensitive TTS.
summary_zh: 当前文本转语音（TTS）模型通常通过预测时长，将音素级编码器状态扩展为帧级解码器输入，以解决文本-语音对齐问题。虽然该长度规整步骤从结构上解决了对齐问题，但传统时长处理方式仅改变隐状态出现的位置与频次，不会改变隐状态本身的取值。本文提出了一种面向TTS时长感知声学建模的连续时间机制，使用神经控制微分方程（CDEs）实现该机制。我们将音素表征建模为时间参数化的控制路径，使用神经声学向量场生成连续时间隐状态，其取值随语音内容与时长衍生的时间信息动态演化。最终得到的轨迹可在离散点采样后接入标准声学解码器流水线。客观实验结果对比了CDE与典型循环模型的性能差异，主观实验结果表明，每步处理一个音素的CDE基模型可以提升合成语音与参考语音的情感强度排序一致性，同时情感表达质量与强基线模型相当。将步长设置为半个音素的补充实验表明，时间分辨率会改变风格跟踪能力与绝对校准精度之间的权衡关系。上述结果证明CDE是面向连续时间、时长感知、风格敏感型TTS的极具潜力的设计方向。

title: A Time-Based Readout for Vector-Matrix Multiplication in Fully Analog Memristive SNNs
title_zh: 全模拟忆阻脉冲神经网络中面向向量矩阵乘法的时间型读出机制
authors: Elia Mateu-Barriendos, Álvaro Gómez-Pau, Josep Rius, Daniel Arumí, Rosa Rodríguez-Montañés 等 (6 人)
abstract: Artificial neural networks rely on vector-matrix multiplications (VMMs), whose implementation in von Neumann architectures is dominated by costly data movement between memory and processing units. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) mitigate this bottleneck by performing in-memory, analog VMMs using memristive crossbar arrays. However, conventional current-mode readout circuits incur significant area and power overhead.This work proposes a fully analog readout architecture based on voltage-to-time conversion of the VMM output. By sensing the column voltage, the proposed approach avoids current-mode summing and scaling circuitry, improving area and energy efficiency. Post-layout simulations of a 10x1 SNN implemented in a 130 nm CMOS technology validate the proposed architecture, while application to a trained 64x10 SNN for digit classification further demonstrates its feasibility for SNN inference.
summary_zh: 人工神经网络的核心运算为向量矩阵乘法（VMM），在冯·诺依曼架构中，该运算的实现成本主要来自存储单元与计算单元之间高昂的数据移动开销。脉冲神经网络（SNNs）可基于忆阻交叉阵列实现存内模拟向量矩阵乘法，有效缓解该瓶颈，但传统电流模式读出电路会带来显著的面积与功耗开销。本文提出了一种基于向量矩阵乘法输出电压-时间转换的全模拟读出架构，该架构通过感知列电压，完全避免了电流模式求和与缩放电路，大幅提升了面积与能量效率。基于130nm CMOS工艺实现的10×1脉冲神经网络的后布局仿真结果验证了该架构的有效性，在训练完成的64×10手写数字分类脉冲神经网络上的应用进一步证明了该架构用于脉冲神经网络推理的可行性。

title: When Agents Disagree: Bayesian Backward Reasoning as a Label-Free Anchor for Multi-Agent Collective Decision-Making
title_zh: 当智能体产生分歧：作为多智能体集体决策无标签锚点的贝叶斯反向推理
authors: Ken Chen, Wei Wang, Sachith Seneviratne, Hansani Weeratunge, Saman Halgamuge
abstract: When multiple LLM agents yield conflicting answers, the decision-making process dictates whether agent diversity improves performance or merely compounds shared errors. Existing collective decision-making methods, including voting, electoral rules, and LLM judges, rely on forward reasoning: they map evidence to labels in one direction. Although these methods can combine diverse forward traces, they still aggregate estimates that share this evidence-to-label factorization and can inherit correlated errors within the forward pool. We therefore construct a reverse posterior for each instance through Bayesian backward reasoning from an explicit likelihood. The forward and reverse posteriors provide differently factorized approximations of the underlying posterior. Because estimates from different factorizations may tend to share the same error less often, we use Jensen-Shannon divergence to rank agents by cross-path consistency. This cross-path consistency signal underlies three strategies: hard selection (MinJS), soft reweighting (FwdJS), and log-linear fusion (LogLin). Evaluated on DDXPlus across five LLM backbones, our proposed strategies show consistent improvements: MinJS outperforms random selection across all backbones, FwdJS generally improves over the strongest baseline, and LogLin achieves the best performance among the evaluated methods, with its largest gains on the subset where the agents disagree. Despite its weaker standalone accuracy, the reverse posterior serves as a more useful anchor than forward-only alternatives, providing complementary information for collective decision-making. When labeled data are available, a lightweight two-stage calibration can further refine the reverse anchor and improve aggregation performance.
summary_zh: 当多个大语言模型（LLM）智能体输出冲突结果时，决策机制将直接决定智能体多样性是提升性能还是仅会放大共同误差。现有集体决策方法包括投票、选举规则和LLM裁判，均依赖前向推理：即单向从证据映射到标签。这类方法虽然可以组合不同的前向推理路径，但聚合得到的估计结果仍共享证据到标签的分解逻辑，会继承前向推理池中的相关误差。为此，本文通过基于显式似然的贝叶斯反向推理，为每个样本构建反向后验分布。前向与反向后验分布对底层真实后验提供了不同分解方式的近似。由于不同分解得到的估计结果出现相同误差的概率更低，本文使用詹森-香农散度，根据跨路径一致性对智能体进行排序。该跨路径一致性信号支撑了三类策略：硬选择策略MinJS、软重加权策略FwdJS和对数线性融合策略LogLin。在DDXPlus数据集上基于5种不同LLM骨干网络开展的实验表明，本文提出的策略实现了一致性能提升：MinJS在所有骨干网络上的表现均优于随机选择，FwdJS性能普遍超过最强基线方法，LogLin在所有参评方法中取得最优表现，且在智能体输出分歧的子集上性能增益最大。尽管反向后验本身的独立准确率更低，但它作为锚点的实用性优于仅使用前向推理的方案，能够为集体决策提供互补信息。当存在标注数据时，轻量的两阶段校准可进一步优化反向锚点，提升聚合性能。

title: COBRA-Skills: Contextual Bandit-Guided Evolution for Agent Skill Optimization
title_zh: COBRA-Skills：面向智能体技能优化的上下文赌博机引导进化框架
authors: Pingchen Lu, Xiangyi Wang, Xiang Li, Jie Mao, Zikun Qu 等 (9 人)
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can benefit from reusable skills distilled from prior task experience, yet existing skill optimization methods often rely on costly execution-based evaluation and substantial task data. We introduce \textbf{COBRA-Skills}, an efficient framework that formulates skill optimization as budgeted sequential optimization over a dynamically evolving candidate space. COBRA-Skills couples contextual-bandit-guided prioritization with evidence-grounded skill evolution, selectively allocating evaluations to promising or informative candidates while continually refining the skill population from execution feedback. Across six heterogeneous agent benchmarks and three target models, COBRA-Skills consistently achieves the strongest average performance among compared methods, while reducing optimization cost by 55--58\% relative to SkillOpt and using only 50 unique optimization examples per benchmark. Further analyses show that COBRA-Skills remains robust to changes in the agent harness and performs effectively when the target model itself is used for skill generation and refinement.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可从过往任务经验中蒸馏得到的可复用技能中获益，但现有技能优化方法通常依赖成本高昂的基于执行的评估和大量任务数据。本文提出COBRA-Skills这一高效框架，将技能优化建模为动态演化候选空间上的带预算序列优化问题。COBRA-Skills将上下文赌博机引导的优先级排序与基于证据的技能进化相结合，选择性地将评估资源分配给有潜力或高信息价值的候选对象，同时根据执行反馈持续优化技能种群。在6个异构智能体基准和3个目标模型上的实验表明，COBRA-Skills在所有对比方法中始终取得最优平均性能，相比SkillOpt优化成本降低55%~58%，且每个基准仅使用50个独特的优化样本。进一步分析显示，COBRA-Skills对智能体运行框架的变化具备鲁棒性，当目标模型本身被用于技能生成和优化时也能有效运行。

title: Ecdysis: Efficient and Effective Training of Runtime Harnesses for LLM Agents
title_zh: Ecdysis：面向大语言模型智能体的高效运行时框架训练方法
authors: Ruiqing Yue, Yu Cui, Zhuoyu Sun, Sicheng Pan, Xianhong Xue 等 (14 人)
abstract: Self-evolving runtime harnesses can substantially improve the capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents and provide a promising paradigm for optimizing agent execution. Existing harness evolution methods typically rely on iterative search, repeatedly evaluating and revising candidate harnesses based on execution feedback from task instances. While this paradigm enables continuous harness optimization, it incurs substantial time overhead due to repeated agent executions and code modifications, and may overfit to observed tasks and specific failure patterns, resulting in degraded generalization to unseen tasks. We identify the lack of principled failure diagnosis as a key bottleneck in harness evolution: an observed failure can reflect either model-specific deficiencies or systematic harness deficiencies, and directly optimizing against individual failures can lead to unnecessary model-specific accommodation. We therefore propose Ecdysis, an efficient and effective framework that distinguishes model-specific accommodation from harness-level repair and biases adaptation toward systematic harness deficiencies by identifying recurring cross-task failure patterns. Ecdysis adopts a batch-level cross-instance failure aggregation paradigm to jointly analyze failure evidence from multiple task instances and further introduces Failure-Driven Collaborative Refinement to diagnose failure causes and iteratively refine harness modification specifications. By combining cross-instance failure analysis with multi-role diagnosis, Ecdysis enables more effective harness evolution with lower training time. Experiments show that Ecdysis achieves up to a 1.84x speedup in harness training compared with existing harness evolution methods, while improving the reasoning accuracy of the resulting harnesses by 18.56%.
summary_zh: 自进化运行时框架可大幅提升大语言模型（LLM）智能体的能力，为智能体执行优化提供了极具前景的范式。现有框架进化方法通常依赖迭代搜索，基于任务实例的执行反馈反复评估和修改候选框架。该范式虽然支持框架的持续优化，但反复的智能体执行和代码修改会带来极高的时间开销，还可能对观测到的任务和特定故障模式过拟合，导致对未见过任务的泛化性能下降。本文指出，缺乏严谨的故障诊断机制是框架进化的核心瓶颈：观测到的故障既可能反映模型本身的缺陷，也可能是系统性的框架缺陷，直接针对单个故障优化会导致不必要的模型适配行为。为此，本文提出Ecdysis这一高效框架，可区分模型专属适配和框架层面修复，通过识别跨任务重复出现的故障模式，引导优化过程向系统性框架缺陷倾斜。Ecdysis采用批级跨实例故障聚合范式，联合分析来自多个任务实例的故障证据，进一步提出故障驱动协同优化方法，用于诊断故障原因并迭代优化框架修改规则。通过结合跨实例故障分析与多角色诊断，Ecdysis可在更低训练时间开销下实现更有效的框架进化。实验结果表明，与现有框架进化方法相比，Ecdysis的框架训练速度最高可提升1.84倍，同时将生成框架的推理准确率提升18.56%。

title: Geospatial AI, Dataverse Metadata, and the Study of Place-Based Government
title_zh: 地理空间人工智能、Dataverse元数据与场所导向型政府研究
authors: Danny EBanks, Devika Jain
abstract: Harvard Dataverse hosts over 150,000 research datasets, but the geographic information those datasets carry is entered as free text by depositors and has never been assembled into a searchable structure. We construct a knowledge graph from the repository's public data and metadata, organizing 102,650 datasets within a 215,985-node network of 528,003 edges linking datasets to keywords, publications, subjects, journals, and locations. Of those datasets, 43,991 (42.9 percent) carry at least one geospatial field, geographic coverage, geographic unit, or a bounding box and 96.9 percent of all nodes sit in a single connected component, so datasets remain reachable from one another even when their geospatial metadata share nothing in common. A conservative keyword search identifies 7,654 geospatially tagged datasets (17.4 percent) as directly policy-relevant, with elections and legislatures the largest cluster, followed by government administration, health policy, transportation, and education. Five datasets illustrate how this metadata behaves across policy domains and spatial scales, and an extended use case shows how community language models, stance detection with geographic aggregation, and partisan language bridging tools can attach discourse to place. The central obstacle is place resolution: the same location appears as many disconnected nodes. We argue that the graph provides a concrete setting for developing AI-driven metadata enrichment and entity resolution, and we document its coverage skew toward American, city-level data.
summary_zh: 哈佛数据文库（Harvard Dataverse）托管了超过15万个研究数据集，但这些数据集携带的地理信息均由上传者以自由文本形式录入，从未被整合为可搜索的结构化形式。本文基于该仓库的公开数据和元数据构建知识图谱，将102650个数据集组织为包含215985个节点、528003条边的网络，边将数据集与关键词、出版物、学科、期刊和地理位置关联起来。所有数据集中，有43991个（占比42.9%）至少包含1个地理空间字段、地理覆盖范围、地理单元或边界框，且96.9%的节点位于同一个连通分量中，因此即使数据集的地理空间元数据完全不重叠，彼此之间仍可通过网络关联访问。通过保守的关键词搜索，本文识别出7654个带地理空间标签的数据集（占比17.4%）与政策直接相关，其中选举和立法机构是最大的聚类，其次是政府管理、卫生政策、交通和教育领域。本文通过5个数据集示例展示了该元数据在不同政策领域和空间尺度下的表现，还通过扩展用例展示了社区语言模型、带地理聚合的立场检测、党派语言桥接工具如何将话语与特定场所关联起来。当前的核心障碍是场所解析问题：同一位置可能对应多个互不连通的节点。本文认为该知识图谱为开发AI驱动的元数据富集和实体解析技术提供了具象的场景，同时也记录了该数据集的覆盖偏差：其数据主要偏向美国城市级别的数据。

title: Warrant Theory
title_zh: 保证理论
authors: Khashayar Irani
abstract: In this paper, we develop warrant theory as a philosophical discipline concerned with the inferential legitimacy of propositions within logical analysis. Warrant theory reconceptualises logic as a normative framework governing the conditions under which propositions may be introduced, accepted, rejected, and inferentially employed. Warrant is understood as inferential entitlement and is distinguished from truth, belief, and other psychological attitudes, while its relation to inferential use and meaning is examined. Warrant-theoretic analysis is then developed as a systematic method for investigating how propositions acquire inferential standing, how that standing develops, and how inferential positions interact through relations of dependence, compatibility, incompatibility, and exclusion. Acceptance and rejection provide the bilateral vocabulary for representing positive and negative inferential positions and the consequences and commitments associated with them. Finally, these elements are brought together in a warrant-theoretic definition of logic as the formal and normative study of the conditions under which propositions may be legitimately accepted or rejected and of the inferential transitions that such legitimacy warrants. On this account, logical consequence and logical failure are understood through the presence, preservation, or absence of inferential entitlement, thus locating the philosophical subject matter of logic in the systematic governance of inferential legitimacy.
summary_zh: 本文提出保证理论这一哲学分支学科，聚焦逻辑分析中命题的推理合法性问题。保证理论将逻辑重新概念化为一类规范性框架，用于管控命题可被引入、接受、拒绝和进行推理使用的条件。保证被定义为推理性资格，与真理、信念及其他心理态度明确区分，本文同时探究了其与推理使用、语义之间的关联。保证理论分析被开发为一套系统方法，用于研究命题如何获得推理地位、该地位如何演化，以及推理立场如何通过依赖、兼容、互斥、排除等关系产生交互。接受和拒绝构成了双边词汇，可用于表征正负向推理立场，以及与之相关的后果和承诺。最后，本文将上述要素整合，从保证理论视角将逻辑定义为形式化的规范性研究对象，研究命题可被合法接受或拒绝的条件，以及这类合法性所支撑的推理转换关系。基于该定义，逻辑后承和逻辑失效可通过推理性资格的存在、保留或缺失来理解，从而将逻辑的哲学研究范畴锚定在推理合法性的系统性治理层面。

title: Autonomy, Social Norms, and Alignment: Towards a Developmental Framework for Autonomous Artificial Agents
title_zh: 自主性、社会规范与对齐：面向自主人工智能体的发展性框架
