We consider perturbations obtained by varying the local models of the PGMs within general neighborhoods and focus in particular on epsilon-contamination, total variation distance and chi-squared divergence balls. We test our methods on benchmark datasets, demonstrate that the robustness value of a prediction serves as an indicator for its trustworthiness and compare our approach with other such indicators.
summary_zh: 本文针对两类底层分布为概率图模型（PGM）的生成式分类器：朴素贝叶斯分类器和生成森林（随机森林的概率扩展），提出了计算其预测结果鲁棒性的方法。遵循鲁棒性量化范式，本文将预测结果的鲁棒性定义为：在不改变该预测结果的前提下，分类器的底层分布可被扰动的最大程度。研究考虑了在通用邻域内调整PGM局部模型得到的扰动，重点针对epsilon污染、总变差距离和卡方散度球三类扰动场景开展分析。在基准数据集上的测试结果表明，预测的鲁棒性值可作为预测可信度的有效指标，本文方法的性能优于其他同类可信度评估指标。

title: Estimating Inconsistency Response Surfaces under Uncertainty in Cyber-Physical System Development
title_zh: 信息物理系统开发中不确定性下的不一致响应曲面估计
authors: Johannes Mäkelburg, Tim Schwabe, Maribel Acosta
abstract: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) are commonly represented through multiple interconnected models. During development, CPS consistency requires that shared model elements remain compatible across these models. Uncertainty, for example, due to sensor noise or model abstraction, changes the admissible values of model elements and can introduce inconsistencies, i.e., situations in which models can no longer be jointly satisfied. While existing approaches can determine consistency for a given uncertainty configuration, they provide limited support for systematically exploring, analyzing, and explaining inconsistency across large uncertainty spaces. We address this challenge by reformulating inconsistency as an intervention response modeling problem. Using Saltelli sampling and multi-fidelity Monte Carlo estimation, we generate intervention-response datasets and train a surrogate model that directly predicts inconsistency from the propagated uncertainty geometry. Experiments on 48 scenarios and 10 CPS domains show that the surrogate matches Monte Carlo estimates while reducing evaluation time from milliseconds to microseconds, enabling orders-of-magnitude more response-surface evaluations within fixed computational budgets. Building on the learned response surfaces, we perform sensitivity analysis to identify dominant uncertainty drivers and introduce a gradient-based consistency recourse method to determine minimal uncertainty interventions that restore consistency. The results show that inconsistency under uncertainty can be effectively learned, analyzed, and repaired through response-surface modeling, providing a scalable foundation for uncertainty-aware consistency management in CPS development.
summary_zh: 信息物理系统（CPS）通常由多个互联模型共同表示。在开发过程中，CPS的一致性要求不同模型中的共享元素保持兼容。传感器噪声、模型抽象等带来的不确定性会改变模型元素的允许取值范围，进而引发不一致问题，即多个模型无法同时满足的场景。现有方法可针对给定的不确定性配置判断一致性，但难以支持在大规模不确定性空间中系统性地探索、分析和解释不一致现象。本文将不一致性问题重构为干预响应建模问题以应对该挑战，结合Saltelli采样和多保真蒙特卡洛估计生成干预-响应数据集，训练代理模型直接从传播后的不确定性几何特征预测不一致性。在48个场景和10个CPS域上的实验表明，该代理模型的预测精度与蒙特卡洛估计相当，同时将评估耗时从毫秒级降至微秒级，可在固定计算预算下实现高出数个数量级的响应曲面评估次数。基于学习得到的响应曲面，本文开展敏感性分析识别主导不确定性驱动因素，并提出基于梯度的一致性补救方法，计算可恢复一致性的最小不确定性干预量。实验结果表明，通过响应曲面建模可有效学习、分析和修复不确定性下的不一致问题，为CPS开发中支持不确定性感知的一致性管理提供了可扩展的基础方案。

title: A Dynamic Fusion Large Language Model for Traffic Flow Prediction
title_zh: 面向交通流预测的动态融合大语言模型
authors: Xue Qiu, Jianli Xiao
abstract: Traffic flow prediction is a core supporting technology for intelligent transportation systems. It uses historical data to infer future traffic dynamics in specific areas, thereby helping to alleviate congestion and improve resource allocation efficiency. Traditional neural networks struggle to break through accuracy limits due to their reliance on singular feature modeling, while large language models (LLMs) suffer from insufficient capture of spatial topological information and mining spatiotemporal correlation. This study proposes a Dynamic Fusion Large Language Model (DF-LLM) for traffic flow prediction. The model incorporates three core components: spatiotemporal embedding module, spatiotemporal fusion module, and LLM backbone. The spatiotemporal embedding module enables synergistic representation of multi-scale spatiotemporal features. The spatiotemporal fusion module integrates spatial topology and dynamic dependencies via graph convolution. The LLM backbone adopts a differentiated parameter adaptation strategy to balance training efficiency and traffic data adaptability. Additionally, it introduces a context aggregation attention module to strengthens global dependencies. More importantly, the LLM backbone takes the residual connections to mitigate the gradient vanishing in deep networks. Experiments show that DF-LLM has achieved better performance by comparing the metrics on all the four datasets.
summary_zh: 交通流预测是智能交通系统的核心支撑技术，其利用历史数据推断特定区域未来的交通动态，从而缓解拥堵、提升资源分配效率。传统神经网络依赖单一特征建模，难以突破精度上限；而现有大语言模型（LLM）则存在空间拓扑信息捕获不足、时空关联挖掘能力弱的问题。本文提出面向交通流预测的动态融合大语言模型（Dynamic Fusion Large Language Model, DF-LLM），该模型包含三个核心组件：时空嵌入模块、时空融合模块和LLM主干网络。时空嵌入模块可实现多尺度时空特征的协同表示；时空融合模块通过图卷积融合空间拓扑信息与动态依赖关系；LLM主干网络采用差异化参数适配策略，平衡训练效率与交通数据适配性。此外，模型引入上下文聚合注意力模块强化全局依赖，更关键的是LLM主干网络采用残差连接缓解深度网络的梯度消失问题。在四个公开数据集上的对比实验表明，DF-LLM的各项指标均优于现有基线模型，取得了更优的预测性能。

title: A Two-Mirror Faceted Projection System for EUV Lithography
title_zh: 面向极紫外光刻的双镜面分面投影系统
authors: Vasiliy A. Es'kin, Egor V. Ivanov, Olga V. Martynova
abstract: We propose an all-reflective two-mirror projection system for extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography operating at exposure wavelengths of $13.5$~nm (Mo/Si) and $11.2$~nm (Ru/Be), delivering a fourfold ($4\times$) demagnification of the periodic mask pattern at a numerical aperture approaching unity ($\mathrm{NA}_{\max} \approx 0.993$). In contrast to conventional EUV projection objectives that incorporate 6--10 aspheric mirrors with an overall optical throughput of less than $15\%$, the proposed design redirects each accepted discrete spatial diffraction order scattered by the mask onto the wafer via a dedicated pair of planar mirror facets. The number of reflections is strictly fixed at two for all accepted orders, retaining $50$--$60\%$ of the power leaving the mask in each accepted order. We derive a spatial geometry providing rigorous optical path length equalization across all diffraction orders, thereby removing order-dependent propagation phase shifts. Individually optimized 30-bilayer Bragg multilayer coatings are designed for each facet using the transfer matrix method combined with global evolutionary optimization algorithms. The architecture is generalized to a three-dimensional vector formulation with a two-dimensionally periodic mask. Utilizing inverse lithography technology, Fourier parameterization, and a differentiable electromagnetic modal waveguide solver, we solve the synthesis problem for binary absorber masks (La absorber on a Ru/Be/Sr multilayer mirror). We demonstrate simulated aerial images of sub-10-nm features on the wafer (isolated peaks with a full width at half maximum (FWHM) of approximately $5.4$~nm and line pairs with a critical dimension of $6$~nm) and find that the two peaks remain resolved for the tested wafer defocus values from $0$ to $5$~nm along the $z$-axis.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种全反射式双镜面投影系统，适用于工作波长为13.5 nm（Mo/Si多层膜）和11.2 nm（Ru/Be多层膜）的极紫外（EUV）光刻场景，可对周期性掩模图案实现4倍缩小，最大数值孔径可达0.993。传统EUV投影物镜包含6~10个非球面反射镜，整体光通量低于15%，与之不同的是，本文提出的设计通过一对专用平面镜分面，将掩模散射的所有有效离散空间衍射级次分别重定向到晶圆表面。所有有效衍射级次的反射次数严格固定为2次，可保留掩模出射光中每个有效级次50%~60%的能量。本文推导了可对所有衍射级次实现严格光程差均衡的空间几何结构，消除了不同级次之间的传播相位偏移。结合传递矩阵法和全局进化优化算法，为每个分面单独设计了30层布拉格多层膜涂层。该架构可推广到采用二维周期性掩模的三维矢量形式，结合逆光刻技术、傅里叶参数化和可微电磁模态波导求解器，求解了二元吸收层掩模（Ru/Be/Sr多层反射镜上沉积La吸收层）的合成问题。仿真结果显示，晶圆表面可实现特征尺寸小于10 nm的空间像：孤立峰的半高全宽（FWHM）约为5.4 nm，线对图案的关键尺寸可达6 nm；在z轴方向0~5 nm的晶圆离焦范围内，两个相邻特征峰始终保持可分辨状态。

title: A Hilbert-Valued Functional Decomposition Framework for Explaining Time-Dependent Outputs
title_zh: 用于解释时变输出的希尔伯特值函数分解框架
authors: Sophie Hanna Langbein, Niklas Koenen, Marvin N. Wright, Julia Herbinger
abstract: Feature-based explanations quantify features' influence on model predictions, but are primarily designed for scalar outputs. In many applications, however, outputs are functional or multivariate, such as time-dependent trajectories in demand forecasting. Consequently, existing approaches typically explain each output location independently, ignoring dependencies across the output components. We address this limitation by developing a unified framework for feature-based explanations of time-dependent outputs. Specifically, we generalize functional decomposition to Hilbert-valued prediction functions and extend an existing feature-based explanation framework to this setting. Our framework introduces kernel-based output representations that enable time-dependency-aware explanations at multiple levels of temporal granularity, including time-specific, time-resolved, and time-aggregated, while providing a unified view in which existing methods arise as special cases. We validate our framework on synthetic and real-world data, including intraday financial market volatility prediction and energy demand forecasting.
summary_zh: 基于特征的解释方法可量化特征对模型预测结果的影响，但这类方法最初是针对标量输出设计的。在很多实际应用场景中，模型输出是函数型或多变量的，例如需求预测中的时变轨迹，现有方法通常会独立解释每个输出位置，忽略输出分量之间的依赖关系。本文针对该局限性，开发了一套面向时变输出的统一特征解释框架。具体而言，本文将函数分解推广到希尔伯特值预测函数场景，将现有基于特征的解释框架扩展到该设置下。该框架引入基于核的输出表示，支持在多个时间粒度层面生成感知时间依赖的解释，包括单时间点解释、时间分辨解释和时间聚合解释，现有相关方法均可作为该框架的特例得到。本文在合成数据和真实世界数据集上对框架进行了验证，验证场景包括日内金融市场波动率预测和能源需求预测。

title: Rethinking Radiomap Blind Prediction with Limited Environment and Configuration Representations
title_zh: 基于有限环境与配置表征的无线电地图盲预测再思考
authors: Xiaojie Li, Yu Han, Han Fang, Shangqing Liu, Shi Jin 等 (6 人)
abstract: Radiomap blind prediction infers radiomaps from observable representations of the propagation environment and base station (BS) configuration without field measurements. These representations are inherently incomplete and cannot uniquely determine the target radiomap. Under squared loss, we identify the conditional-mean radiomap as the population-optimal deterministic target and decompose domain risk into target-approximation error and irreducible uncertainty. The train-test risk gap motivates propagation priors as cross-domain guidance, although their partial or simplified forms may bias the attainable predictor. We therefore propose RadioDecomp, which treats a prior-guided predictor as a correctable base and uses deterministic residual refinement to learn its remaining predictable discrepancy. We instantiate RadioDecomp as RadioLSR (LoS-Shadow-Residual). Experiments under cross-configuration and cross-environment settings show that RadioLSR is especially effective for cross-configuration generalization and provides overall gains over a controlled monolithic counterpart under cross-environment generalization.
summary_zh: 无线电地图盲预测可在无需现场测量的前提下，仅通过传播环境与基站（BS）配置的可观测表征推断无线电地图。这类表征天然存在信息不完备的缺陷，无法唯一确定目标无线电地图。在平方损失下，我们将条件均值无线电地图确定为群体最优确定性目标，并将域风险分解为目标近似误差与不可约不确定性。训练-测试风险差表明传播先验可作为跨域指导，但传播先验的局部或简化形式可能会使可实现预测器产生偏差。为此我们提出RadioDecomp（先验引导残差修正框架），将先验引导预测器视为可修正的基础模块，通过确定性残差细化学习其剩余的可预测偏差。我们将RadioDecomp实例化为RadioLSR（视距-阴影-残差模型）。跨配置与跨环境场景下的实验结果表明，RadioLSR在跨配置泛化任务中表现尤为突出，且在跨环境泛化场景下的整体性能优于受控的单体基准模型。

title: MUtE: A Dual Framework for Concept Erasure and Counterfactual Interventions
title_zh: MUtE：面向概念擦除与反事实干预的双框架
authors: Antoine Saillenfest
abstract: Erasing concept-specific information from representations has been proven useful for mitigating bias or interpreting model decisions. The joint objective is to transform the original representations such that the target concept becomes unpredictable, while maximally preserving concept-unrelated information. In this work, we revisit the optimal bounds of concept erasure to derive a novel class of erasure functions that naturally induce a deterministic, dual counterfactual mapping. Bridging the gap between theoretical optimality and practical representation learning, we design an implementation that imposes a translational bias on counterfactual trajectories - a constraint that aligns with how many concepts geometrically manifest in modern language models. Our framework enables seamless navigation between concept erasure and counterfactual generation. We empirically demonstrate its efficacy in improving downstream algorithmic fairness and generating counterfactual texts.
summary_zh: 从表征中擦除特定概念信息已被证实可有效缓解偏差或提升模型决策的可解释性。该任务的联合优化目标是对原始表征进行变换，使得目标概念无法被预测，同时最大限度保留与目标概念无关的信息。本研究重新审视了概念擦除的最优边界，推导得到一类全新的擦除函数，该类函数可自然生成确定性的对偶反事实映射。为填补理论最优性与实际表征学习之间的空白，我们设计了一种在反事实轨迹上施加平移偏差的实现方案，该约束与现代语言模型中大量概念的几何呈现规律相契合。本框架可在概念擦除与反事实生成之间实现无缝切换，我们通过实验验证了其在提升下游算法公平性与生成反事实文本方面的有效性。

title: Polyhedral Geometry of Time-to-First-Spike Neural Networks
title_zh: 首次脉冲时间神经网络的多面体几何特性研究
authors: Manjot Singh, Guido Montúfar, Gitta Kutyniok
abstract: We study the expressivity of spiking neural networks, which provide a natural framework for asynchronous, event-driven computation complementary to conventional feedforward neural networks. We consider the time-to-first-spike model in a setting for which the input-output map is continuous and piecewise linear, with affine pieces governed by causal feasibility constraints that determine which presynaptic spikes occur before a neuron fires. We first show that each neuron's firing time admits a maxout-like representation with exponentially many, highly constrained affine pieces. We then formalize causal regions as polyhedral regions with fixed causal sets and derive upper and lower bounds on the maximal number of causal regions in both shallow and multilayer feedforward spiking networks. Our theoretical and experimental results show that spiking networks can generate richer partitions of the input space than conventional feedforward ReLU networks.
summary_zh: 本文研究脉冲神经网络的表达能力，这类网络为异步、事件驱动的计算提供了天然框架，可对传统前馈神经网络形成有效补充。我们针对输入输出映射为连续分段线性的场景研究首次脉冲时间模型，其仿射分段由因果可行性约束决定，该约束明确了神经元发放前哪些突触前脉冲会发生。我们首先证明，每个神经元的发放时间可采用类maxout表征，其包含数量呈指数级增长且约束性极强的仿射分段。随后我们将因果区域形式化为具有固定因果集的多面体区域，并推导了浅层与多层前馈脉冲网络中最大因果区域数的上下界。理论与实验结果表明，脉冲神经网络可比传统前馈ReLU网络生成更丰富的输入空间划分。

title: Legible Failures: Detecting and Repairing In-Context Binding Errors
title_zh: 可解释失效：检测与修复上下文内绑定错误
authors: Manas Venkata Sai Ravulapalli, Samrath Singh Chadha, Abhinav M. Hari
abstract: A wrong answer does not show whether the model lacked the needed information or held it and failed to use it. On an entity-obligation binding task, a language model can emit an incorrect prompt-supplied binding while a linear probe can recover the correct one from its frozen hidden state. We measure how often this occurs across 16 public checkpoints, each evaluated with three seeds. We fit a probe on a training fold, select its layer on a validation fold, and report results on a disjoint test fold. On the trials each model gets wrong, probe accuracy exceeds the strict present-obligation baseline, 1/K = 0.125, by +0.196 (95% CI [+0.101, +0.296], bootstrapped over models). A query-entity counterfactual rules out token presence and recency. A score built from the sign of probe-output disagreement improves failure detection over the model's own confidence by +0.079 AUROC (95% CI [+0.036, +0.126]). Raw probe confidence gives no measurable improvement over model confidence. Steering the residual stream toward the probe-decoded binding, with no gold label, raises accuracy on all eight models tested by a mean of +0.168 (95% CI [+0.066, +0.280]). Where recent studies report that probe-detected errors are resistant to interventions, we find that in-context binding is a setting in which probes are actionable.
summary_zh: 错误输出无法区分模型是缺失所需信息，还是已存储相关信息但未能正确调用。在实体-义务绑定任务中，语言模型可能输出错误的提示词提供的绑定结果，但线性探测仪可从其冻结的隐藏状态中恢复出正确的绑定结果。我们在16个公开模型检查点上（每个检查点采用3个随机种子评估）统计了该现象的发生频率：在训练集上拟合探测仪，在验证集上选择最优层，在独立测试集上报告结果。在所有模型预测错误的试次中，探测仪准确率比严格的当前义务基线1/K=0.125高出0.196（95%置信区间[0.101, 0.296]，基于模型自举抽样）。查询实体反事实实验排除了令牌存在性与近因性的干扰。基于探测仪输出不一致符号构建的分数，其失效检测性能比模型自身置信度高出0.079 AUROC（95%置信区间[0.036, 0.126]）。原始探测仪置信度相比模型置信度未表现出可测量的性能提升。在无黄金标签的前提下，将残差流引导至探测仪解码的绑定结果，可使全部8个测试模型的准确率平均提升0.168（95%置信区间[0.066, 0.280]）。近期研究指出探测仪检测到的错误难以被干预，而本研究证实上下文内绑定是探测仪可有效落地的场景。

title: Diversity of EML-type operators
title_zh: EML型算子的多样性研究
authors: Andrzej Odrzywołek
abstract: The discovery of the EML operator, sufficient to evaluate the standard explicit purely transcendental elementary functions, has led to considerable interest and discussion across multiple scientific disciplines. However, most authors have focused on the binary EML itself, while numerous similar variants with slightly different properties are now known. This article attempts to close this gap by enumerating and classifying them. We also take this opportunity to clarify common misconceptions related to the EML operator. The principal goal, symbolic regression within an architecture as close as possible to proven neural networks which combine matrix multiplication with a single univariate non-linear activation function, remains beyond reach. Instead, we propose a Möbius layer, with rational functions replacing matrix operations, and showcase the recently discovered activation function eml(x,1/x), which allows exp(x) and ln(x) to be recovered separately, and hence all elementary functions to be evaluated within a rational generalization of the neural network.
summary_zh: 可用于计算标准显式纯超越初等函数的EML算子的发现，已在多个科学领域引发广泛关注与讨论。但现有研究大多聚焦于二元EML算子本身，目前已知大量性质略有差异的同类变体尚未得到系统梳理。本文通过枚举与分类这类变体填补了该研究空白，同时厘清了与EML算子相关的常见误解。本领域的核心目标是在尽可能接近已验证神经网络（结合矩阵乘法与单变量非线性激活函数）的架构内实现符号回归，目前该目标仍未达成。为此我们提出了莫比乌斯层，用有理函数替代矩阵运算，并展示了近期发现的激活函数eml(x,1/x)，该激活函数可分别还原exp(x)与ln(x)，因此可在神经网络的有理泛化框架内计算所有初等函数。

title: REVA: Reusable Evidence View Aggregation for Context-Efficient RAG Serving
title_zh: REVA：面向上下文高效检索增强生成（RAG）服务的可复用证据视图聚合框架
authors: Tuan Nguyen, Qiran Hu, Banruo Liu, Khoa D. Doan, Kok-Seng Wong 等 (6 人)
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves knowledge-intensive large language model (LLM) applications by conditioning generation on retrieved documents, but longer contexts increase latency, key-value (KV) cache memory, and token cost. Post-retrieval compression can reduce this cost, yet existing compressors often operate independently for each query, rely on auxiliary models or rewriting, and introduce online overhead that can offset the benefit of shorter prompts. We revisit RAG compression from a data-mining perspective by aggregating historical query--document--model interactions into reusable evidence views. We first show that modern compressors have unstable gains over simple truncation and can add substantial inference-time latency. We then propose Reusable Evidence View Aggregation (REVA), a framework that mines the target generator's historical attention traces into a document-keyed, budget-agnostic score store. REVA maps token-level attention to readable word units, aggregates importance across repeated document accesses, and renders budget-specific plain-text views that preserve document order and the standard RAG interface. Across four representative benchmarks and modern LLMs, REVA improves generation quality by 1.0--5.8 points over existing advances, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 5.3 to 15.6, adding less than 40 ms of latency.
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过基于检索到的文档生成内容，提升知识密集型大语言模型（LLM）应用的性能，但更长的上下文会增加延迟、键值（KV）缓存内存占用与令牌成本。检索后压缩可降低该类成本，但现有压缩器通常针对每个查询独立运行，依赖辅助模型或重写操作，引入的在线开销可能抵消短提示词带来的收益。本研究从数据挖掘视角重新审视RAG压缩问题，将历史查询-文档-模型交互聚合为可复用的证据视图。我们首先证实，现有先进压缩器相比简单截断的性能提升不稳定，且会大幅增加推理时延。随后提出可复用证据视图聚合（REVA）框架，该框架挖掘目标生成器的历史注意力轨迹，构建以文档为键、与预算无关的分数存储库。REVA将令牌级注意力映射为可读的词单元，聚合重复文档访问的重要性信息，生成保留文档顺序且兼容标准RAG接口的预算定制纯文本视图。在4个代表性基准与主流大语言模型上的实验结果表明，REVA相比现有先进方案将生成质量提升1.0~5.8个点，同时将压缩开销降低5.3至15.6倍，引入的额外时延不足40毫秒。

title: Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets (CONES) under Time-Varying Loss Functions
title_zh: 时变损失函数下的嵌套演化可行集凸优化（CONES）研究
authors: Rahul Vaze
abstract: Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets (CONES)} was introduced in \cite{CONESVaze} where the objective function \(f\) remains fixed but the feasible region evolves over time as a nested sequence \(S_1 \supseteq S_2 \supseteq \cdots \supseteq S_T\). The goal of an online algorithm is to simultaneously minimize the regret with respect to hindsight static optimal benchmark and the total movement cost $M_\cA(T)$ while ensuring feasibility at all times. CONES is an optimization-oriented generalization of the well-known \emph{nested convex body chasing} (NCBC). In this paper, we extend CONES to allow for loss functions $f_t'$s to also change over time. When all loss functions are convex, we show that the projected proximal algorithm achieves $O(T^{1-\beta}), O(T^\beta)$ simultaneous regret and movement cost, respectively, for any $\beta \in [0,1)$, over a time horizon of $T$. We also show that any {\it weakly adaptive} online algorithm with $O(T^\beta)$ regret has a movement cost of $\Omega\left(T^{\frac{1-\beta}{2}}\right)$ for any $\beta \in [0,1)$. When all loss functions are strongly convex, we show that the projected proximal algorithm simultaneously achieves $O(1)$ regret and a movement cost of $O(\log T)$. To complement this, we show that any online algorithm with sublinear {\it anytime} regret has a movement cost of $\Omega\left(\log T\right)$.
summary_zh: 嵌套演化可行集凸优化（CONES）最早在文献CONESVaze中提出，其设定下目标函数f保持固定，可行域随时间演化形成嵌套序列S₁⊇S₂⊇⋯⊇S_T。在线算法的优化目标是同时最小化相对于事后静态最优基准的遗憾与总移动成本M_A(T)，并全程保证可行性。CONES是经典嵌套凸体追踪（NCBC）问题面向优化场景的泛化。本文将CONES扩展到损失函数f_t也随时间动态变化的场景。当所有损失函数均为凸函数时，我们证明在时长为T的时间范围内，投影近点算法可对任意β∈[0,1)同时实现O(T^{1-β})级别的遗憾与O(T^β)级别的移动成本。同时我们证明，对任意β∈[0,1)，任意具有O(T^β)级遗憾的弱自适应在线算法的移动成本下界为Ω(T^{(1-β)/2})。当所有损失函数均为强凸函数时，投影近点算法可同时实现O(1)级别的遗憾与O(log T)级别的移动成本。作为补充，我们证明任意具有次线性随时段遗憾的在线算法的移动成本下界为Ω(log T)。

title: Hierarchical Clustering Can Jointly Satisfy Richness, Consistency, and Scale Invariance
title_zh: 层次聚类可同时满足丰富性、一致性与尺度不变性公理
authors: Daichi Kuroda, Maximilien Dreveton, Matthias Grossglauser, Patrick Thiran
abstract: Despite its ubiquity, clustering lacks a universally accepted definition of what is a cluster. Kleinberg's Impossibility Theorem formalizes this difficulty by showing that no flat clustering method can simultaneously satisfy three natural axioms: scale invariance, richness, and consistency. In this paper, we ask whether this impossibility persists when the output is a hierarchy rather than a single partition. We show that, in contrast to the flat clustering setting, the hierarchical analog of these axioms are jointly satisfiable. In fact, there exist uncountably many hierarchical clustering methods satisfying these axioms, which we call admissible. We explicitly construct several admissible methods, including methods based on well-separated clusters and a non-binary version of single linkage. For certain pairs of admissible methods, the hierarchy produced by one always refines that produced by the other. This refinement relation defines a partial order on the class of admissible methods. This partially ordered set has no greatest element and contains uncountably many pairwise incompatible maximal elements, revealing substantial diversity among admissible methods. Nevertheless, this diversity is constrained: every admissible method contains a hierarchy of sufficiently well-separated clusters, and every finite collection of admissible methods shares such a nontrivial common backbone.
summary_zh: 尽管聚类技术应用广泛，但目前学界尚未形成关于“簇”的普适定义。Kleinberg不可能定理从形式上证实了该难点：不存在任何平面聚类方法可同时满足尺度不变性、丰富性与一致性三条自然公理。本文探讨当输出为层次结构而非单一划分时，该不可能结论是否仍然成立。我们证明，与平面聚类场景不同，上述三条公理的层次化等价形式可同时被满足。事实上，存在无穷多可同时满足这些公理的层次聚类方法，我们将其称为可接受方法。我们显式构造了多种可接受方法，包括基于良好分离簇的方法与非二元版本的单连接聚类方法。对于部分可接受方法对，其中一个方法生成的层次结构始终是另一个方法生成层次结构的细化，该细化关系在可接受方法类上定义了偏序。该偏序集不存在最大元，且包含无穷多两两不可兼容的极大元，说明可接受方法具有极高的多样性。但该多样性也存在约束：所有可接受方法都包含足够良好分离簇的层次结构，任意有限个可接受方法都共享这类非平凡公共主干结构。

title: Semi-Tensor Product-Based Multi-Term Randomized T-SVD and Its Visual Applications
title_zh: 基于半张量积的多项随机T-SVD及其视觉应用研究
authors: Xingchen Xiao, Feng Zhang, Wenjin Qin, Jianjun Wang
abstract: Tensor singular value decomposition (T-SVD), which is built upon the tensor-tensor product (t-product), has emerged as a powerful tool for processing high-dimensional visual data such as color images and videos. However, the standard t-product imposes strict dimensional compatibility constraints. Although extensions based on the semi-tensor product (STP) relax this restriction, their single-term formulations still suffer from limited approximation accuracy. Moreover, these deterministic methods incur high computational costs when processing large-scale tensor data. To address these issues, this paper introduces a novel semi-tensor product for third-order tensors under the t-product framework induced by arbitrary invertible linear transforms. The resulting tensor semi-tensor product breaks the rigid dimension matching requirement of the standard t-product, while retaining the closed-form property of T-SVD. Based on this construction, we develop a multi-term semi-tensor product singular value decomposition (MSTP-SVD), which integrates multiple orthogonal decomposition terms to significantly improve low-rank approximation accuracy compared with single-term schemes. To reduce the computational cost of multi-term modeling, we incorporate randomized projection and power iteration techniques into the MSTP-SVD framework, yielding an accelerated multi-term randomized semi-tensor product SVD (MRSTP-SVD) algorithm that achieves a balance between reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency. Experiments on image and video compression and completion tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
summary_zh: 建立在张量-张量积（t-product）基础上的张量奇异值分解（T-SVD）是处理彩色图像、视频等高维视觉数据的强大工具。但标准t-product施加了严格的维度兼容性约束，基于半张量积（STP）的扩展方案虽放松了该限制，但其单项形式的近似精度仍然有限。此外这类确定性方法在处理大规模张量数据时计算成本极高。为解决上述问题，本文在任意可逆线性变换诱导的t-product框架下，提出了面向三阶张量的新型半张量积，得到的张量半张量积打破了标准t-product的严格维度匹配要求，同时保留了T-SVD的闭式解性质。基于该构造，我们开发了多项半张量积奇异值分解（MSTP-SVD），该方法整合多个正交分解项，相比单项方案大幅提升了低秩近似精度。为降低多项建模的计算成本，我们将随机投影与幂迭代技术整合到MSTP-SVD框架中，得到加速版多项随机半张量积奇异值分解（MRSTP-SVD）算法，实现了重建精度与计算效率的平衡。图像与视频压缩、补全任务上的实验结果证实了所提方法的有效性。

title: When does a spectral prior help graph learning? Connectivity-loss estimation under road-network disruptions
title_zh: 谱先验何时可助力图学习？道路网络中断场景下的连通性损失估计研究
authors: Van-Truong Le
abstract: Rapid evaluation of many simultaneous road-link disruptions requires a practical compromise between exact spectral recomputation and local approximation. We estimate relative algebraic-connectivity loss after multi-edge deletion using graph neural networks (GNNs) that learn a bounded correction to a first-order Fiedler sensitivity. The study considers independent, spatially clustered, and edge-betweenness-targeted failures, with graph-disjoint synthetic splits and zero-shot transfer to 13 OpenStreetMap (OSM) areas in six countries. GCN, GraphSAGE, and edge-aware MPNN backbones are compared with analytical baselines. In expanded OSM tests, residual GCN improves spatial-failure MAE by 0.0391 (95% hierarchical interval 0.0151-0.0662), while residual GraphSAGE improves targeted-failure MAE by 0.0257 (0.0095-0.0446). Second-order perturbation improves first-order MAE by only 0.0028-0.0053. Correction slopes decrease under targeted transfer, indicating residual shrinkage around systematic prior error. Leave-one-country-out OSM-to-OSM transfer is mixed: residual GCN improves targeted-failure MAE by 0.0622 (0.0169-0.1153) but worsens the spatial point estimate. Sparse scaling extends to 20,000 nodes and separates one-time spectral setup from amortized screening cost. These results characterize the spectral residual as a useful but domain-sensitive inductive bias for structural connectivity screening. Code, cached networks, and reproducibility artifacts are archived at doi:https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22307723.
summary_zh: 快速评估大量同时发生的道路链路中断，需要在精确谱重计算与局部近似之间做出实用权衡。我们利用图神经网络（GNN）学习一阶Fiedler灵敏度的有界修正，估计多边删除后的相对代数连通性损失。本研究考虑独立故障、空间聚集故障与边介数定向故障三类场景，采用图不相交的合成数据集划分，并在6个国家的13个开放街图（OSM）区域上完成零样本迁移测试。对比的基线模型包括GCN、GraphSAGE与边感知MPNN骨干网络以及分析基准。在扩展开放街图测试中，残差GCN将空间故障的平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了0.0391（95%分层置信区间0.0151-0.0662），残差GraphSAGE将定向故障的平均绝对误差降低了0.0257（0.0095-0.0446）。二阶扰动仅将一阶方法的平均绝对误差提升了0.0028-0.0053。定向迁移场景下修正斜率下降，表明系统先验误差附近的残差收缩。留一国家的开放街图跨区域迁移结果存在差异：残差GCN将定向故障的平均绝对误差降低了0.0622（0.0169-0.1153），但空间点估计性能出现下降。稀疏缩放方案可扩展至20000个节点，将一次性谱设置成本与摊销筛选成本分离。上述结果表明，谱残差是面向结构连通性筛选的有效但对域敏感的归纳偏置。代码、缓存网络与可复现性资源已归档至https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22307723。

title: LILA: Calibration-Free Structured Pruning of Large Language Models via Latent Spectral Geometry
title_zh: LILA（潜空间感知层分析）：基于潜谱几何的大语言模型无校准结构化剪枝方法
authors: Sankar Behera, Dhruv Singh, Anshika Agnihotri, Raj Kumar Choudhary, Satyadev Ahlawat 等 (6 人)
abstract: Structured pruning of large language models (LLMs) offers hardware-efficient compression, yet existing methods require calibration data, gradient computation, or large auxiliary policy networks at pruning time. LILA (\emph{Latent-Informed Layer Analysis}) scores neuron importance via the Kolmogorov--Smirnov (KS) distance between empirical singular value distributions of the full and neuron-ablated feed-forward network (FFN) weight matrix, providing a closed-form spectral rule requiring no training, calibration data, or auxiliary network. Without any fine-tuning, LILA surpasses PruneNet (45M-parameter RL policy) by 1.57~pp in zero-shot accuracy on LLaMA-2-7B at 25\% sparsity, and outperforms WikiText-2-calibrated SliceGPT by up to 6.0~pp across all sparsity levels, while preserving the original architecture. After one epoch of LoRA recovery fine-tuning, LILA achieves highly competitive performance, matching the heavily calibrated SliceGPT baseline to within a 0.48~pp margin across LLaMA-2-7B and Phi-2, despite using zero calibration data. A Neural Tangent Kernel analysis confirms a 22$\times$ reduction in functional distortion versus random pruning, providing theoretical grounding for the spectral importance criterion. Finally, extending LILA to dynamically allocate sparsity budgets via KS-scores yields state-of-the-art generative preservation at moderate compression, while uncovering fundamental single-layer architectural bottlenecks at higher compression regimes.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的结构化剪枝可实现硬件友好的模型压缩，但现有剪枝方法在剪枝阶段需要依赖校准数据、梯度计算或大规模辅助策略网络。LILA（Latent-Informed Layer Analysis，潜空间感知层分析）通过计算完整前馈网络（FFN）权重矩阵与神经元消融后的前馈网络权重矩阵的经验奇异值分布之间的柯尔莫哥洛夫-斯米尔诺夫（KS）距离来评估神经元重要性，提出了一种无需训练、校准数据或辅助网络的闭式谱规则。在不进行任何微调的情况下，在25%稀疏度下对LLaMA-2-7B模型进行剪枝时，LILA的零样本准确率比采用45M参数强化学习策略的PruneNet高出1.57个百分点；在所有稀疏度水平下，其性能均比经WikiText-2校准的SliceGPT高出最多6.0个百分点，同时完全保留原始模型架构。仅经过1轮LoRA（低秩适配）恢复微调后，尽管完全未使用任何校准数据，LILA的表现仍极具竞争力，在LLaMA-2-7B和Phi-2两个模型上与经过大量校准的SliceGPT基线的性能差距仅为0.48个百分点。神经正切核分析结果证实，与随机剪枝相比，LILA将模型的功能失真降低了22倍，为该谱重要性准则提供了理论支撑。最后，将LILA扩展为通过KS得分动态分配稀疏度预算后，在中等压缩率下实现了当前最优的生成能力保留效果，同时在高压缩率场景下识别出了基础的单层架构瓶颈。

title: Bidirectional Multimodal Fusion of Sky Images and Time-Series for Solar Forecasting with Large Language Models
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的天空图像与时间序列双向多模态融合太阳能预测方法
authors: Ken Chen, Maneesha Perera, Wei Wang, Sachith Seneviratne, Hansani Weeratunge 等 (6 人)
abstract: Short-term photovoltaic (PV) power and global horizontal irradiance (GHI) forecasts are essential for effective dispatch, reserve scheduling, and grid operations. At these forecasting horizons, errors are predominantly driven by cloud induced ramps: relying solely on historical numerical data may struggle to anticipate an incoming cloud, making ground-based sky images a crucial complementary physical signal. Furthermore, forecast performance is highly sensitive to location and local observing conditions, creating a strong need for site-specific data that are often scarce. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated competitive performance and high data efficiency in time-series forecasting. Despite their success, existing LLM-based forecasting methods remain predominantly unimodal, relying primarily on historical numerical time-series data. Effectively incorporating sky imagery into an LLM-based forecasting framework remains under-explored and an open challenge. In this paper, we propose SolCloudLLM, an LLM-based multimodal forecasting framework. SolCloudLLM aligns sky-image patches with time-series patches and fuses their corresponding representations through bidirectional multimodal fusion, yielding a unified representation that is subsequently mapped into the embedding space of an LLM. Extensive experiments on the SIRTA and SKIPP'D datasets demonstrate that SolCloudLLM consistently outperforms the best baseline methods in MSE across all forecasting horizons, achieving a maximum relative MSE reduction of 25.4%. Stratified analysis further indicates that the benefits of multimodal fusion are concentrated primarily under cloudy conditions. Notably, SolCloudLLM achieves the best performance in nearly all few-shot settings, whereas other deep learning baselines experience substantial performance degradation and are frequently outperformed by the non-learning physical method.
summary_zh: 短期光伏（PV）功率和水平面总辐照（GHI）预测是实现高效调度、备用规划和电网运行的核心基础。在这类预测时间尺度下，预测误差主要由云层移动导致的功率骤变引发：仅依赖历史数值数据往往难以预判即将到来的云层，因此地面拍摄的天空图像成为至关重要的互补物理信号。此外，预测性能对地理位置和本地观测条件高度敏感，导致对站点专属数据的需求极强，而这类数据通常十分稀缺。近年来，大语言模型（LLM）在时间序列预测任务中展现出了极具竞争力的性能和极高的数据效率。但现有基于LLM的预测方法大多为单模态架构，主要依赖历史数值时间序列数据，如何将天空图像有效融入基于LLM的预测框架仍有待探索，是当前领域的公开挑战。本文提出了SolCloudLLM，一种基于LLM的多模态预测框架。SolCloudLLM将天空图像块与时间序列块进行特征对齐，通过双向多模态融合机制融合二者的对应表征，生成统一表征后映射到LLM的嵌入空间。在SIRTA和SKIPP'D两个公开数据集上开展的大量实验表明，SolCloudLLM在所有预测时间尺度下的均方误差（MSE）指标上均持续优于最优基线方法，最高可实现25.4%的相对MSE降低。分层分析进一步表明，多模态融合的性能增益主要集中在多云场景下。值得注意的是，SolCloudLLM在几乎所有少样本设置下都取得了最优性能，而其他深度学习基线方法则出现了显著的性能下降，甚至经常被非学习类物理方法超越。

title: Phase-Decoupled, Model-Calibrated Power Control for Disaggregated LLM Serving
title_zh: 面向解耦大语言模型服务的相位解耦、模型校准功率控制方法
authors: Jae Gon Kim, Donghoon Yoo, Hanyul Ryu, Sungho Ha, Juyeon Lee 等 (6 人)
abstract: Datacenter GPU power is the binding constraint on LLM serving capacity, and production serving has shifted to prefill/decode (PD) disaggregation. Deploying NVIDIA's Max-Q inference profile on a disaggregated B200 system, we found its realized gain modest (+8.6% tokens/J), model-dependent, and carrying a mean end-to-end latency cost (+5.2%) that throughput-only evaluation does not surface; the profile also applies one setting to prefill and decode GPUs that operate in opposite hardware regimes. We hypothesize that the optimal power setting is a property of the deployed (model, quantization, engine, hardware) combination rather than of the GPU class, that each lane warrants its own profile, and that converting SLO headroom into energy safely requires latency-gated calibration under a runtime SLO guard rather than a fixed recipe. We present a phase-decoupled, model-calibrated controller: the prefill lane runs under an SM-clock window whose floor is a latency guarantee by construction, and the decode lane under a power cap placed by automatic calibration just above a measured throughput/latency cliff. Because a disaggregated decode lane draws flat, memory-bound power, the cap binds continuously, the reactive-overshoot weakness that led POLCA to reject capping is absent, and the GPU's own power manager retains throughput under the cap. On an 8x B200 node serving Qwen3-Coder-480B (FP8) under agentic load, our balanced mode delivers +20.4% tokens/J at +3.5% mean e2e versus +8.6% at +5.2% for Max-Q, a Pareto improvement on both axes. On Qwen3-235B-A22B (NVFP4) every operating mode meets the ITL-p99 SLO in every repetition; both vendor profiles miss it. A decode-actuator A/B shows the calibrated cap beats static clock locks, and a three-day sustained run saves 32.3% of a lane pair's electricity. Both models are MoE; a dense model recovers roughly 5x less, so we scope our claims to MoE serving.
summary_zh: 数据中心GPU的功耗是限制大语言模型服务容量的核心约束，当前生产级大模型服务已普遍转向预填充/解码（PD）解聚架构。我们在解聚部署的B200系统上运行NVIDIA官方的Max-Q推理配置后发现，其实际性能增益十分有限（单位焦耳输出token数仅提升8.6%），且增益效果与部署模型强相关，同时还带来了平均5.2%的端到端延迟开销，这类开销在仅评估吞吐量的测试中完全无法被发现；此外该配置对预填充GPU和解码GPU采用完全相同的参数设置，但两类GPU实际处于完全相反的硬件运行区间。我们提出假设：最优功率设置是所部署的（模型、量化方案、推理引擎、硬件）组合的固有属性，而非仅由GPU型号决定，预填充和解码两条服务链路应当各自拥有独立的配置方案，同时要在运行时服务水平目标（SLO）的约束下通过延迟门控校准，才能安全地将SLO余量转化为能耗收益，而非依赖固定的预设规则。本文提出了一种相位解耦、经模型校准的控制器：预填充链路在流多处理器（SM）时钟窗口内运行，该窗口的下限通过构造即可保证延迟符合要求；解码链路则运行在自动校准得到的功耗上限下，该上限值略高于实测得到的吞吐量/延迟突变点。由于解聚后的解码链路处于内存绑定状态，功耗曲线十分平缓，该功耗上限可持续生效，此前导致POLCA方法拒绝使用功耗上限的反应过冲缺陷完全消失，GPU自身的功耗管理模块也可在上限约束下尽可能保留吞吐量。在部署Qwen3-Coder-480B（FP8精度）的8卡B200节点上运行智能体负载时，我们的平衡模式可在平均端到端延迟仅提升3.5%的前提下，将单位焦耳输出token数提升20.4%，相比Max-Q方案延迟提升5.2%、能效提升8.6%的表现，实现了两个维度上的帕累托优化。在部署Qwen3-235B-A22B（NVFP4精度）的场景下，我们的所有运行模式在所有重复测试中均满足p99端到端延迟SLO，而厂商提供的两种预设配置均无法达标。解码控制模块的A/B测试结果表明，经校准的功耗上限性能优于静态时钟锁定方案，连续3天的稳定运行测试可将一对服务链路的电力消耗降低32.3%。本文测试的两个模型均为MoE（混合专家）架构，在稠密模型上该方案的能效提升幅度约为前者的1/5，因此本文的结论适用范围限定于MoE大模型服务场景。

title: How Wrong Can a Good Predictor Be? Diverging Updates with Vanishing Predictive KL
title_zh: 优秀预测器的偏差上限：预测KL散度趋于零时的更新发散现象
authors: Qifu Wen, Shuaijun Liu, Zihan Zhou, Xi Zeng, Ningxin Su
abstract: Accurate posterior prediction need not require accurate approximation of Bayesian updates. We prove that an unbounded gap between the update maps can coexist with vanishing predictive KL for every fixed finite $K\ge2$ in a stationary symmetric Gaussian HMM. Exact Bayesian mixing and an explicit deterministic radial filter act on the same $K-1$ belief coordinates. As $q\to0^+$, their separation in centered logits in the worst case grows at least linearly in the natural confidence scale $L_K(q)$, while their categorical $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\mathrm{exact}\|\mathrm{radial})$ vanishes at the same explicit witness. Along stationary HMM trajectories, the expected terminal KL between filtered posteriors also converges to zero at $H(q)=\lceil-\log(q)/c\rceil+1$. Typical blocks without switches drive both filters into a common confidence cone, where softmax curvature suppresses their disagreement; a single Gaussian maximal event controls adaptive noise. A sweep with equally spaced Gaussians over $K\in\{2,4,8\}$ illustrates the opposing trends, and binary controls at long horizons compare saturating and nonsaturating recurrences. The result isolates two missing links between internal update gaps and predictive cost: the contribution of separating states to expected loss and decoder sensitivity. Thus even an unbounded internal update gap does not by itself certify predictive failure. The construction is fixed in $K$ and does not provide a universal criterion for when compression is harmless or characterize when internal gaps must incur task loss.
summary_zh: 实现精准的后验预测并不需要对贝叶斯更新过程进行完全精确的近似。本文证明，在平稳对称高斯隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）中，对于任意固定的有限整数K≥2，更新映射之间的无界差距可以与所有场景下预测KL散度趋于零的现象共存。精确贝叶斯混合过程与显式确定性径向滤波器作用在完全相同的K-1维信念坐标上。当q→0⁺时，最坏情况下二者在中心化对数几率空间的分离度至少会随自然置信度尺度L_K(q)线性增长，而二者的分类KL散度D_KL(精确分布||径向分布)却会在同一显式观测点处趋于零。在平稳HMM的运行轨迹上，经滤波得到的后验分布之间的期望终端KL散度也会以H(q)=⌈-log(q)/c⌉+1的速率收敛到零。不含状态切换的典型运行块会将两个滤波器驱动到同一个置信锥内，该区域内softmax的曲率会抑制二者的分歧，单个高斯极大事件即可控制自适应噪声。我们在K∈{2,4,8}的范围内用等间隔高斯分布开展的遍历测试验证了上述两种相反的变化趋势，长时程下的二元控制实验对比了饱和递归与非饱和递归的特性。该研究明确了内部更新差距与预测代价之间此前缺失的两个关联环节：状态分离对期望损失的贡献，以及解码器的敏感度。因此，即使是无界的内部更新差距本身也不能直接判定预测任务会失败。本文提出的构造方法固定在K维度下，并未给出判断压缩是否无害的通用准则，也没有刻画内部差距必然导致任务损失的边界条件。

title: HERALD: High-Fidelity Exemplar Retrieval with Adaptive Landmark Distillation for Heterophily-Aware Graph Condensation
title_zh: HERALD：面向异质性感知图压缩的自适应地标蒸馏高保真样例检索方法
authors: Sujan Chakraborty, Priyanka Saha, Saptarshi Bej
abstract: Graph condensation aims to produce a small surrogate graph that preserves the downstream node-classification performance of a much larger original graph. Existing methods rely on Weisfeiler-Lehman neighbourhood aggregation or gradient-based distribution matching, both of which assume that adjacent nodes share the same label, an assumption that breaks down under heterophily. We propose HERALD (High-fidelity Exemplar Retrieval with Adaptive Landmark Distillation), a gradient-free graph condensation framework that adapts the node scoring and feature selection in the condensation pipeline to the graph's measured heterophily. HERALD selects features via a joint Fisher-discriminability and activation-density criterion that down-weights aggregated representations on heterophilic graphs, and scores nodes by a weighted combination of prototype representativeness, decision-boundary proximity, and Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID), where the weights are driven by a smooth sigmoid function of the heterophily ratio. Nodes are then assembled into a condensed subgraph through score-ordered BFS expansion, Personalised PageRank pruning, and class rebalancing, all at an identical storage budget to BONSAI, enabling direct comparison. Experiments on eight benchmark datasets spanning homophilic and heterophilic settings show that HERALD matches or outperforms state-of-the-art condensers on heterophilic graphs and remains competitive on homophilic ones across four GNN architectures.
summary_zh: 图压缩的目标是生成一个小型代理图，保留远大于其规模的原始图在下游节点分类任务上的性能。现有方法依赖维费勒-莱曼（Weisfeiler-Lehman）邻域聚合或基于梯度的分布匹配，两类方法都假设相邻节点共享相同标签，该假设在异质性图场景下完全不成立。本文提出HERALD（High-fidelity Exemplar Retrieval with Adaptive Landmark Distillation，自适应地标蒸馏高保真样例检索），这是一种无梯度的图压缩框架，可根据图的实测异质性程度自适应调整压缩流水线中的节点评分和特征选择策略。HERALD通过联合费希尔判别性和激活密度准则选择特征，在异质性图中对聚合表征进行降权处理；同时结合原型代表性、决策边界邻近度和局部本征维度（LID）的加权组合对节点进行评分，权重由异质性比率的平滑sigmoid函数动态决定。之后通过按评分排序的广度优先搜索扩展、个性化页面排名剪枝和类别重平衡操作，将选中的节点组装为压缩子图，整个过程的存储预算与基线方法BONSAI完全一致，可实现公平直接的性能对比。在覆盖同质性和异质性场景的8个基准数据集上开展的实验表明，HERALD在异质性图上的性能与当前最优图压缩方法持平甚至更优，同时在同质性图上针对4种不同的图神经网络（GNN）架构也保持了极具竞争力的表现。

title: Beyond Solver Verdicts: Generative Reward Models for Autoformalization
authors: Vikash Singh, Debargha Ganguly, Aman Goel, Ali Torkamani, Xiaoxue Han 等 (8 人)
abstract: Neurosymbolic systems rely on mathematical solvers to guarantee reasoning correctness, yet solvers are fundamentally blind to whether a formal translation maintains strict reference-equivalence to a designated formalization. We formalize this vulnerability as Verdict-Preserving-Unfaithfulness (VPU): a failure mode where an incorrect encoding executes successfully and matches the expected verdict. We theoretically prove that structural, verdict-only verification heuristics are mathematically bounded to chance-level detection on these deceptively valid traces. To resolve this, we introduce Generative Verification (GenV), which distills an offline Z3-equivalence oracle into a reference-free, continuous reference-equivalence score by repurposing the language model's native vocabulary space. Mechanistic analysis via decision-projected logit lenses and sparse autoencoders shows this generative readout natively extracts precise spatial error coordinates without explicit localization training. Empirically, our oracle-mined verifier (GenV+HN) achieves 0.961 AUROC in reference-equivalence verification, generalizes zero-shot across unseen translators and divergent formal styles, and yields an 11.3-point downstream accuracy gain in agentic test-time compute allocation.

title: Coherent Floquet quantum reservoirs for molecular property prediction
title_zh: 用于分子性质预测的相干弗洛凯量子储层
authors: Luofei Wang, Da Zhang, Congren Wang, Yiming Li, Yuxiao Yang 等 (8 人)
abstract: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) uses quantum dynamics to represent input histories for prediction through a trained classical readout. Discrete time crystals (DTCs) exhibit robust subharmonic responses under periodic driving, and previous work has used their dynamics to construct DTC-QRC. Here we construct a DTC-based reservoir architecture to predict molecular properties from structural and dynamical observations. Coherent Floquet evolution processes local molecular graph events and surface-hopping frames, while controlled reset regulates the contribution of earlier inputs. Measurements at the end of each input sequence yield a feature vector of fixed dimension. Trained classical decoders use this vector for inhibitor-activity and blood--brain-barrier permeability classification and electronic-gap forecasting, while the reservoir parameters remain fixed during training. With matched input lengths and output widths, DTC-QRC outperforms echo-state networks on long-prefix graph classification and the studied ethene gap forecasting tasks. Dephasing lowers performance in both applications, consistent with a role for coherent propagation. Experiments on the Quafu superconducting quantum cloud platform show that pair observables retain task information under device noise. The architecture provides a common framework for molecular screening and time-resolved property prediction using quantum reservoir computing.
summary_zh: 量子储层计算（QRC）利用量子动力学表征输入历史，通过训练后的经典读出层实现预测任务。离散时间晶体（DTC）在周期性驱动下会展现出鲁棒的次谐波响应，此前已有研究利用其动力学特性构建了DTC-QRC架构。本文构建了一种基于DTC的储层架构，可从分子结构和动力学观测数据中预测分子性质。相干弗洛凯（Floquet）演化过程对分子图事件和表面跳帧进行局部化处理，同时受控重置机制可调节早期输入的贡献占比。在每个输入序列结束时开展测量，即可得到维度固定的特征向量。训练完成的经典解码器利用该特征向量完成抑制剂活性分类、血脑屏障通透性分类和电子带隙预测任务，整个训练过程中储层参数保持固定不变。在输入长度和输出宽度匹配的前提下，DTC-QRC在长前缀图分类任务和乙烯带隙预测任务上的表现均优于回声状态网络。退相干会降低两类应用的性能，该结果与相干传播的作用机制一致。在Quafu超导量子云平台上开展的实验表明，配对可观测量可在设备噪声环境下保留任务相关信息。该架构为利用量子储层计算开展分子筛选和时间分辨性质预测提供了统一框架。

title: When Noise Fabricates Bias: The Fragility of LLM-as-a-Judge Bias Measurement under Noisy Text
title_zh: 噪声如何生成偏差：噪声文本场景下大语言模型作为评判者的偏差测量脆弱性研究
authors: DongHyun Ryu, Jaehyeok Lee, YeongJun Hwang, JinYeong Bak
abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to measure social bias in text, yet the passages they judge are often noisy, containing typos, informal spelling, and broken punctuation. The consequences of such surface noise for social bias measurement remain unclear. To investigate this question, we apply five realistic noise conditions at multiple intensity levels to 3,822 stereotype-related responses and compare the resulting bias judgments with those on the original text. We find that such surface noise does not degrade bias measurement symmetrically: it is far more likely to turn neutral judgments into biased ones than biased judgments into neutral ones, by up to a 120x margin. We further observe two non-obvious effects across four LLM judges: in the most fragile judge the distortion is at its purest at mild, realistic noise levels, where erasure is scarcest, and as judges grow robust it attenuates toward parity rather than reversing. Bias measured on noisy text is therefore systematically overestimated, most in the categories that matter most for fairness.
summary_zh: 当前大语言模型越来越多地被用作评判者，测量文本中包含的社会偏差，但它们评判的文本往往存在噪声，包含拼写错误、非正式拼写和残缺标点。这类表面噪声对社会偏差测量结果的影响目前尚不明确。为探究该问题，我们对3822条与刻板印象相关的响应文本施加了5种不同强度的真实噪声条件，将得到的偏差评判结果与原始文本的评判结果进行对比。研究发现，这类表面噪声对偏差测量的影响是非对称的：将中性评判误判为有偏差的概率远高于将有偏差的评判误判为中性的概率，二者的差距最高可达120倍。我们进一步在4种不同的大语言模型评判器上观测到两个此前未被发现的效应：在最脆弱的评判器上，偏差失真在轻度真实噪声水平下达到峰值，此时文本内容被擦除的概率最低；而随着评判器鲁棒性提升，该非对称效应会逐渐衰减直至两类误判概率持平，而非出现反向反转。因此，在噪声文本上测得的偏差值会被系统性高估，在对公平性最重要的偏差类别中高估程度最为显著。

title: The information geometry of large language models is shared, learned, and controllable
title_zh: 大语言模型的信息几何：共享性、可学习性与可控性
authors: Dario Picozzi
abstract: Large language models learn similar behaviours, yet it remains unclear what structure they share or how to change one behaviour without disturbing others. The Fisher-Rao geometry of next-token probabilities connects these questions: behaviour determines this geometry up to output-preserving symmetries, whereas activation geometry depends on coordinates. Across transformer, state-space and recurrent models, output geometries agree more strongly than activation geometries, and shared geometry supports semantic-category transfer. Agreement with human word choices increases with predictive accuracy, scale and training, and improves further after model-only calibration. Token probabilities and read-out geometry jointly predict the spectrum and its effective dimension. Controlled language assignments show that geometry follows the language law across architectures. Pretraining corpus statistics predict held-out fact acquisition without recalibration, while randomised experiments show that deeper evidence substantially delays acquisition across every tested architecture and evidence construction. Finally, the geometry prescribes minimum-disturbance local interventions, predicts their relative cost, and supports reusable control: updates learned on donor prompts transfer to unseen prompts while better preserving behaviour on reference prompts than Euclidean control. The same geometric correction improves steering, editing, attribution, dictionary learning and fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 不同大语言模型会学习到相似的行为模式，但目前学界仍不清楚它们共享的底层结构是什么，也不清楚如何在不干扰其他行为的前提下修改某一特定行为。下一个token概率的费希尔-拉奥（Fisher-Rao）几何将这两个问题关联起来：模型行为决定了该几何结构（在输出保持不变的对称变换下唯一），而激活空间的几何结构则依赖于坐标表示。在Transformer、状态空间模型和循环模型三类架构中，输出空间几何的一致性远高于激活空间几何的一致性，且共享几何结构支持语义类别迁移。模型与人类选词偏好的匹配度会随预测准确率、模型规模和训练过程提升，在仅针对模型本身做校准后还会进一步提升。token概率和读出层几何可共同预测模型的谱分布及其有效维度。受控语言分配实验表明，不同架构下的几何结构均遵循语言定律。预训练语料的统计特征可在无需重新校准的前提下预测模型对未见过的事实的习得能力，而随机对照实验表明，在所有测试的架构和证据构造方式下，增加训练证据的深度都会显著延迟事实习得过程。最后，该几何结构可指导实现最小扰动的局部干预，预测不同干预的相对代价，支持可复用的模型控制：在源提示上学到的参数更新可迁移到未见过的目标提示上，同时相比欧几里得空间控制方法，能更好地保留参考提示上的原有行为。该几何校正方法可同时提升模型引导、编辑、归因、词典学习和微调的效果。

title: EMMI: Edge Multi-Modal Intelligence for Communication-Efficient MLLM Inference via Fused Representation Compression
title_zh: EMMI：基于融合表征压缩的通信高效多模态大模型推理边缘多模态智能框架
authors: Motahare Mounesan, Irfan Khan
abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language mod- els (MLLMs) have opened new opportunities for edge intelligence by enabling reasoning across heterogeneous sensor modalities, such as vision, text, and telemetry data. However, deploying these capabilities on resource-constrained edge platforms remains challenging due to the substantial computational, memory, and communication demands of modern MLLMs. Rather than transmitting raw sensor observations or partitioning neural networks at intermediate layers, Edge Multi-Modal Intelligence (EMMI) communicates a compact representation between edge devices and server resources, enabling communication-efficient edge MLLM inference. To achieve this, EMMI performs modality-specific encoding, cross-modal representation fusion, and learned compression at the edge, transmitting only a compact latent representation to server-side resources for high-capacity MLLM reasoning. This representation-centric design reduces communication overhead, preserves local data privacy, and provides a fixed-size interface between heterogeneous edge devices and server-side MLLMs. Evaluation on a representative multimodal benchmark demonstrates that EMMI can reduce the communication payload by 32x while maintaining comparable downstream accuracy, resulting in up to a 3.4x reduction in estimated end-to-end inference latency under bandwidth-constrained edge conditions.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）领域的最新进展支持跨视觉、文本、遥测等异构传感器模态的推理，为边缘智能带来了新的机遇。但由于现代MLLM极高的计算、内存和通信需求，在资源受限的边缘平台上部署这类能力仍然极具挑战性。不同于传输原始传感器观测数据或在中间层对神经网络进行切分的传统思路，EMMI（Edge Multi-Modal Intelligence，边缘多模态智能）在边缘设备与服务器资源之间传输紧凑表征，实现了通信高效的边缘侧MLLM推理。为实现该目标，EMMI在边缘侧完成模态专属编码、跨模态表征融合和可学习压缩，仅将紧凑的潜表征传输到服务器端资源，由服务器侧的高算力MLLM完成推理。这种以表征为核心的设计大幅降低了通信开销，保护了本地数据隐私，同时为异构边缘设备和服务器侧MLLM提供了统一的固定大小接口。在代表性多模态基准数据集上开展的评估表明，EMMI可将通信负载降低32倍，同时保持与基线相当的下游任务准确率，在带宽受限的边缘场景下，最高可将端到端推理延迟降低3.4倍。

title: Rebalancing Token Importance in Language Models with TF-IDF Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss
title_zh: 基于TF-IDF加权交叉熵损失的语言模型令牌重要性重平衡方法
authors: Zhijian Li, Stefan Larson, Kevin Leach
abstract: Large language models are typically trained under uniform token weighting, which allows frequent and low-information tokens to dominate learning and can increase the tendency to memorize surface-level text spans. To address this, we present an information-weighted cross-entropy loss that rescales token-level contributions using TF-IDF statistics, emphasizing semantically informative tokens while down-weighting ubiquitous ones. Experiments on five decoder-only LLMs ranging from 1.1B to 13B parameters show consistent reductions in memorized substring length while preserving perplexity and downstream task performance. Under LoRA fine-tuning, TF-IDF reduces average substring memorization length by 14% across all five models. Under full-weight fine-tuning on TinyLLaMA 1.1B, the reduction reaches 58%. Our approach is architecture-agnostic and can be incorporated into existing training pipelines with less than 3% computational overhead, offering a lightweight and principled way to mitigate memorization without disrupting standard training dynamics.
summary_zh: 大语言模型通常在统一令牌加权机制下训练，该机制会让高频低信息令牌主导学习过程，提升模型记忆表层文本片段的倾向。为解决该问题，本文提出一种信息加权交叉熵损失，利用TF-IDF统计量重新缩放令牌级别的贡献，在降低通用高频令牌权重的同时，提升语义信息丰富令牌的权重。在参数量从1.1B到13B的5个仅解码器大语言模型上开展的实验表明，该方法可在保持困惑度和下游任务性能不变的前提下，持续降低模型记忆的子串长度。在LoRA（低秩适配）微调设置下，该方法可使全部5个模型的平均子串记忆长度降低14%；在TinyLLaMA 1.1B的全权重微调场景下，降幅可达58%。本方法与模型架构无关，可在计算开销低于3%的前提下嵌入现有训练流水线，是一种轻量且原理性的缓解模型记忆问题的方案，不会干扰标准训练动态。

title: A variational physics-informed graph neural network for heterogeneous solid mechanics
title_zh: 面向异质固体力学的变分物理信息图神经网络
authors: Aashay Rajan Yadav, Amiya Prakash Das, Ratna Kumar Annabattula
abstract: Stress localization in heterogeneous solids is governed by the bimaterial interface, where the displacement field remains $C^0$-continuous, while in-plane stresses jump due to the stiffness mismatch. Coordinate-based physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) represent this jump via a prescribed regularization width or a weighted interface penalty, making their accuracy sensitive to how phase-contrast changes are handled. This work presents a variational, label-free physics-informed graph neural network (PI-GNN) in which the heterogeneity is carried by the discretization rather than by the trial field. The solver operates on a conforming adaptive mesh graph, assigns constitutive behavior per element, and minimizes the discrete total potential energy as a single unweighted objective in which only first derivatives appear. The discrete energy on piecewise-linear elements coincides with the finite element (FE) Ritz functional. Dirichlet conditions are enforced by construction, with no penalty term, no interface weight, and no prescribed transition width. Using one fixed architecture, optimizer, and loss across small-strain elasticity and finite-strain Neo-Hookean hyperelasticity in two and three dimensions, the von Mises error remains below $3.58\%$ across a stiffness-contrast sweep spanning $(E_{\mathrm{inc}}/E_{\mathrm{mat}}\in[10^{-2},10^{2}])$, where a strong-form PINN degrades to $5.58\%$, and its displacement error reaches $7.66\%$ against $0.49\%$ for the PI-GNN. A trained network halves the ($\sigma_{xx}$) error of an energy-based PINN ($5.01\%$ versus $10.94\%$). Training cost exceeds a single FE solve by more than an order of magnitude, so the construction is a variationally consistent, penalty-free interface representation for parametric surrogates and inverse identification rather than a replacement for a one-off FE analysis.
summary_zh: 异质固体中的应力局部化由双材料界面控制，该界面处位移场保持C⁰连续，而由于刚度不匹配，面内应力会发生跳变。基于坐标的物理信息神经网络（PINNs, Physics-Informed Neural Networks）需要通过预设正则化宽度或加权界面惩罚项来表征该跳变，导致其精度对相对比度变化的处理方式十分敏感。本文提出一种无标签的变分物理信息图神经网络（PI-GNN, Physics-Informed Graph Neural Network），该方法将异质性承载在离散化过程中而非试函数中。该求解器运行在相容自适应网格图上，为每个单元分配本构行为，将离散总势能最小化为单一无加权目标，仅涉及一阶导数。分段线性单元上的离散能量与有限元（FE）里茨泛函完全一致。狄利克雷条件通过构造方式实现，无需惩罚项、界面权重或预设过渡宽度。在二维和三维的小应变弹性、有限应变新胡克超弹性场景下，使用固定的架构、优化器和损失函数，在刚度对比度扫掠范围E_inc/E_mat∈[10⁻²,10²]内，该方法的冯·米塞斯误差始终低于3.58%，而强形式PINN的误差会劣化至5.58%，其位移误差达7.66%，相比之下PI-GNN的位移误差仅为0.49%。训练得到的网络可将基于能量的PINN的σ_xx误差降低一半（5.01%对比10.94%）。该方法的训练成本比单次有限元求解高出一个数量级以上，因此该构造是一种变分自洽、无惩罚的界面表征方案，适用于参数代理模型和反问题识别，而非替代单次有限元分析。

title: Thompson Sampling for Non-Monotone Convex Ridge Bandits: Monotonicity Is Not Needed for Polynomial Regret
title_zh: 非单调凸岭多臂老虎机问题的汤普森采样：多项式遗憾无需单调性假设
authors: Xuan Li
abstract: Bakhtiari, Lattimore and Szepesvári (COLT 2025) proved that Thompson sampling (TS) has Bayesian regret $\tilde O(d^{5/2}\sqrt n)$ for bandit convex optimisation with convex \emph{monotone} ridge losses $f(x)=\ell(\ip{x}{\theta})$, and asked whether monotonicity of the link is necessary. We give a qualitative negative answer. For every prior on $[0,1]$-valued, $1$-Lipschitz convex ridge losses with an arbitrary convex, possibly non-monotone, link, and for any fixed measurable selection of minimisers, exact-posterior TS has Bayesian regret $O\big((d+1)^4\sqrt{dn}\,\log(e+nd\max\{1,\diam K\})\big)=\tilde O(d^{9/2}\sqrt n)$. The monotone proof relies on a single-removal John-ellipsoid dichotomy; we show by an explicit twelve-point configuration that this dichotomy fails for non-monotone links, and replace it by an $O(d^2)$ cardinality bound for ``uninformative'' configurations. The bound uses a Boolean rounding argument: a $0$-$1$ matrix within $1/(4r)$ in max-norm of a rank-$r$ matrix has rank at most $2r-1$. We construct $d(d+1)$ uninformative losses, showing that the cardinality bound is tight up to constants in the large-diameter-to-gap regime, and give a self-contained information-ratio-to-regret transfer that is uniform over fixed measurable selections. Whether the $d^{5/2}$ dependence of the monotone case can be retained remains open.
summary_zh: Bakhtiari、Lattimore和Szepesvári（COLT 2025）证明，对于具有凸单调岭损失f(x)=ℓ(⟨x,θ⟩)的凸优化多臂老虎机问题，汤普森采样（TS, Thompson Sampling）的贝叶斯遗憾为Õ(d^(5/2)√n)，并提出链接函数的单调性是否为必要条件的开放问题。本文给出了定性的否定答案：对于所有取值在[0,1]上的1-利普希茨凸岭损失的先验分布，任意凸的、可能非单调的链接函数，以及任意固定的可测极小值选择规则，精确后验汤普森采样的贝叶斯遗憾为O((d+1)^4√(dn) log(e+nd max{1,diam K}))=Õ(d^(9/2)√n)。针对单调场景的证明依赖于单删除约翰椭球二分法，本文通过显式的12点构型证明该二分法对非单调链接函数不成立，并将其替换为适用于“无信息”构型的O(d²)基数界。该界基于布尔舍入论证：若一个0-1矩阵在最大范数下与秩r矩阵的距离不超过1/(4r)，则其秩至多为2r-1。本文构造了d(d+1)个无信息损失，证明在大直径-间隙机制下该基数界在常数因子范围内是紧的，并给出了在固定可测选择规则下统一的、从信息比到遗憾的自包含转换方法。单调场景下d^(5/2)的依赖关系是否可以保留仍为开放问题。

title: Phases in a class of associative memories via hidden neurons
title_zh: 基于隐藏神经元的一类联想记忆的相变研究
authors: Toshihiro Ota, Masato Taki
abstract: Associative memory in the Hopfield network is attractor dynamics in a disordered many-body system, and higher-order and exponential extensions turn its retrieval update into softmax attention. The polynomial and exponential regimes have been analyzed by different methods, with no common architecture in which to ask what fixes the storage scale. In this paper we study the bipartite architecture of Krotov and Hopfield, which we call the class $H$, whose model is fixed by a Lagrangian for each layer, taking the hidden neurons as the order parameter of retrieval. At polynomial load the replica method yields the replica-symmetric phase diagrams and closed-form capacities, and the crosstalk moment is common to Ising and spherical visible neurons, so their differences come from the visible entropy. With a softmax hidden layer the load is exponential, and a copy representation maps the thermodynamics onto random-energy-model counting, with paramagnetic, condensed, and frozen phases. Heating destabilizes retrieval by quantized reassignments of attention, and typical Gaussian patterns remain metastable at every load. The regimes differ in their crosstalk statistics, central-limit at polynomial load and large-deviation at exponential load, and the class $H$ splits retrieval into two roles, the visible Lagrangian fixing stability and the hidden one the storage scale, two axes that may also guide the design of new Lagrangians.
summary_zh: 霍普菲尔德网络中的联想记忆是无序多体系统中的吸引子动力学，高阶和指数级扩展可将其检索更新过程转化为Softmax注意力。现有研究已采用不同方法分析多项式机制和指数机制，但尚未存在统一架构可用于探究存储规模的决定因素。本文研究Krotov和Hopfield提出的二分架构，将其命名为H类模型，该模型由每一层的拉格朗日量确定，将隐藏神经元作为检索过程的序参量。在多项式负载场景下，采用复本方法可得到复本对称相图和闭式容量，且交叉扰动量对伊辛可见神经元和球形可见神经元是通用的，二者的差异仅来源于可见熵。当隐藏层采用Softmax结构时，负载呈指数级，通过副本表示可将热力学过程映射到随机能量模型计数，得到顺磁相、凝聚相和冻结相三个相态。升温会通过注意力的量化重分配破坏检索过程的稳定性，典型的高斯模式在所有负载下均保持亚稳态。两类机制的交叉扰动统计特性存在差异：多项式负载下服从中心极限分布，指数负载下服从大偏差分布。H类模型将检索过程拆分为两个独立部分：可见层拉格朗日量决定稳定性，隐藏层拉格朗日量决定存储规模，这两个维度也可为新拉格朗日量的设计提供指导。

title: When More Is Not Better: Component Anti-Synergy in a P300 Speller
title_zh: 过犹不及：P300拼写器中的组件反协同效应
authors: Lucas Yang, Rui Liu, Fusheng Wang
abstract: P300 brain-computer interface (BCI) spellers can provide hands-free communication for people with severe motor impairments. Modern pipelines combine multiple individually promising components, often assuming that 'more-is-better'. We tested this assumption using a four-component full-factorial experiment varying the inclusion of Euclidean Alignment (EA), xDAWN spatial filtering, subject calibration, and language model priors on a public P300 dataset. Performance was evaluated using accuracy, repetitions, and information transfer rate (ITR) with mixed-effects models. Results show that the value of components is conditional rather than additive. Calibration was the strongest singular contributor, while EA compensated for its absence in zero-calibration settings. Adding independently useful components could also reduce performance, revealing component anti-synergy. Contrary to conventional wisdom, LM support was not universally beneficial: its effect depends strongly on the strength of the underlying EEG pipeline, while results from a larger LM showed a similar pattern. Together, these findings challenge maximal 'all-on' pipeline design and highlight the value of selecting spatial and language-support components according to the quality of available EEG evidence.
summary_zh: P300脑机接口（BCI）拼写器可为重度运动障碍人群提供免手持通信能力。现代流水线通常会组合多个单独表现优异的组件，默认遵循“越多越好”的假设。本文通过四组件全因子实验对该假设进行验证，实验变量包括是否加入欧几里得对齐（EA）、xDAWN空间滤波、受试者校准和语言模型先验，实验基于公开P300数据集开展。采用混合效应模型，以准确率、重复次数和信息传输率（ITR）作为性能评估指标。结果表明，组件的作用是条件性的而非可加的：校准是贡献最大的独立组件，而欧几里得对齐可在零校准场景下弥补校准缺失带来的性能损失。加入独立表现优异的组件反而可能降低整体性能，证明了组件反协同效应的存在。与传统认知不同，语言模型的辅助作用并非普适有益：其效果高度依赖底层EEG流水线的性能，采用更大规模语言模型的实验也呈现出相同规律。上述结论对“全组件开启”的最大化流水线设计思路提出了挑战，凸显了根据可用EEG证据的质量选择空间滤波组件和语言支持组件的重要价值。

title: Measuring the Value of World-Model Updates: A Counterfactual Utility Protocol for Continual Adaptation
title_zh: 衡量世界模型更新的价值：面向持续自适应的反事实效用协议
authors: Anqi Peter Li, Kaden Kim
abstract: Continual world models must decide whether new data justify changing the model. Fixed replay schedules and prediction-error triggers specify when to update, but neither reveals the value of an individual update: one deployment run cannot show how the same model would have performed at that moment had it held its parameters. We introduce the fork ledger, which branches a deployment stream at pre-registered decision points into matched update and hold continuations under common random numbers. It evaluates both continuations on the same episodes and records $\Delta R = R_{\mathrm{update}} - R_{\mathrm{hold}}$. Always applying one fixed update mechanism lowers return on all three simulated control tasks: CartPole ($-144.0$; checkpoint-bootstrap $95\%$ CI $[-185.4,-116.1]$, against a converged return near $650$), Walker ($-82.8$; $[-101.1,-61.7]$) and Cheetah ($-18.6$; $[-29.0,-6.6]$). Divergence is an outcome of applying the update, so the estimand counts every attempted fork; restricted to the $693$ of $720$ that did not collapse, CartPole and Walker are unchanged in sign ($-113.4$ and $-82.1$) and Cheetah becomes unresolved ($-3.9$; $[-17.5,+13.0]$). The task is the unit of inference: each contributes $240$ attempted forks over five pretrained checkpoints crossed with two drift directions. The ledger makes counterfactual utility observable for a fixed mechanism, allowing triggers to be judged by the updates they select rather than by surprise detection alone.
summary_zh: 持续运行的世界模型需要判断新数据是否值得触发模型更新。固定重放调度和预测误差触发机制仅能指定更新时机，却无法量化单次更新的实际价值：单次部署运行无法体现若模型在对应时刻保持参数不变，其在同一场景下的表现差异。本文提出分支账本机制，该机制在预注册的决策点处将部署流分支为匹配的更新延续分支和保持参数不变的延续分支，两个分支共享相同的随机数。两个延续分支在完全相同的片段上评估性能，记录收益差ΔR = R_update - R_hold。在三个模拟控制任务上的实验表明，始终应用固定更新机制会降低收益：CartPole任务收益下降144.0（自举95%置信区间[-185.4,-116.1]，收敛收益约为650），Walker任务收益下降82.8（置信区间[-101.1,-61.7]），Cheetah任务收益下降18.6（置信区间[-29.0,-6.6]）。分布偏移是应用更新后的结果，因此估计量统计所有尝试的分支；在720次尝试中排除693次未发生崩溃的样本后，CartPole和Walker的收益差符号保持不变（分别为-113.4和-82.1），Cheetah的收益差变为不显著（-3.9，置信区间[-17.5,+13.0]）。任务是推断的基本单元：每个任务在5个预训练检查点和2个漂移方向的交叉组合下共开展240次分支尝试。该账本机制可观测固定更新机制的反事实效用，使得触发机制可通过其选择的更新的实际效果进行评估，而非仅依赖异常检测结果。

title: Empirical Evaluation of Data Poisoning Attacks in Supervised Learning
title_zh: 监督学习中数据投毒攻击的实证评估
authors: Toshif Khan, Muhammad Abusaqer
abstract: Data poisoning corrupts training data to degrade a model or to plant attacker-controlled behavior. This study evaluates two representative training-time attacks, label flipping and backdoor poisoning, on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST with three baseline classifiers: Logistic Regression, Linear SVM, and Random Forest. Clean training is compared with poisoning rates of 5%, 10%, and 20% using clean-test accuracy, macro-precision, macro-recall, macro-F1, and, for backdoors, attack success rate. Label flipping caused clear degradation, largest for Logistic Regression and Linear SVM, while Random Forest stayed comparatively stable. Backdoor poisoning reached attack success rates from 0.9667 to 1.0000 on both datasets and all three models while often keeping clean-test performance near baseline. The results separate indiscriminate poisoning, which shows up in standard metrics, from targeted backdoor poisoning, which stays comparatively stealthy while embedding highly effective malicious behavior, and they support security-oriented evaluation beyond conventional clean-test metrics.
summary_zh: 数据投毒通过篡改训练数据来劣化模型性能或植入攻击者可控的恶意行为。本研究在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上，针对逻辑回归、线性支持向量机和随机森林三类基线分类器，评估两类代表性训练时攻击：标签翻转攻击和后门投毒攻击。对比干净训练场景与投毒率为5%、10%、20%的场景，评估指标包括干净测试集准确率、宏精确率、宏召回率、宏F1值，针对后门攻击额外统计攻击成功率。实验结果表明，标签翻转攻击会造成明显的性能劣化，其中逻辑回归和线性支持向量机受影响最大，而随机森林的表现相对稳定。后门投毒攻击在两个数据集的三类模型上均可达到0.9667到1.0000的攻击成功率，同时通常可保持干净测试集性能接近基线水平。研究结果区分了两类投毒的特性：无差别投毒的影响可通过标准指标观测，而定向后门投毒的隐蔽性更强，可在嵌入高有效性恶意行为的同时几乎不被常规指标发现，该结果也说明需要建立超越传统干净测试指标的面向安全的评估体系。

title: The Platonic brain bridge hypothesis: human brain networks as an architectural prior for omni models
title_zh: 柏拉图脑桥假说：作为全模态模型架构先验的人脑网络
authors: Pengfei Zhang, Biao Tian, Xiangang Li, Li Liu
abstract: We propose the Platonic brain bridge hypothesis: omni models, which process video, audio and text jointly like the brain, converge on brain-like representations, and the correspondence is bidirectional. From model to brain, brain-likeness of seven omni models is stable across participants, and our encoding models on their internal hidden states rank first on the Algonauts 2025 out-of-distribution leaderboard. From brain to model, three contributions follow. Brain-MoE gives seven cortical networks one brain-pretrained expert each and raises held-out accuracy in all 15 model-benchmark pairs by 6.42 percentage points on average. Brain-AVQA builds questions from video clips labelled by the most responsive brain network; the real network-to-expert map exceeds shuffled maps in-domain on all three models. Brain-Scope uses sparse autoencoders to localize the correspondence to a small subset whose removal weakens brain prediction in all three bases tested. Human brain networks are therefore a usable architectural prior for omni models.
summary_zh: 本文提出柏拉图脑桥假说：像人脑一样联合处理视频、音频和文本的全模态模型，会收敛到类脑表征，且二者的对应关系是双向的。从模型到脑的方向：7个全模态模型的类脑特性在不同受试者间保持稳定，基于其内部隐藏状态构建的编码模型在Algonauts 2025分布外排行榜上位列第一。从脑到模型的方向，本文提出三项贡献：Brain-MoE为7个皮层网络分别分配一个脑预训练专家，在全部15个模型-基准对中平均将留出集准确率提升6.42个百分点；Brain-AVQA基于响应最强的脑网络标注的视频片段构建问题，真实的脑-专家映射在域内测试中在全部三个模型上的表现均优于打乱后的映射；Brain-Scope采用稀疏自编码器将对应关系定位到一小部分子集，移除该子集后，所有三个测试基底下的脑预测性能均会下降。因此人脑网络可作为全模态模型的有效架构先验。

title: Empirical Evaluation of Membership Inference Attacks on NLP Text Classifiers: A Baseline Study on SST-2
title_zh: NLP文本分类器上成员推理攻击的实证评估：基于SST-2的基线研究
authors: William Novak, Muhammad Abusaqer
abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) try to determine whether a specific record was used to train a model, a privacy risk that matters in natural language processing (NLP), where training data can contain sensitive user text. This paper presents a controlled benchmark of membership inference vulnerability for text classification on the GLUE SST-2 sentiment dataset. A TF-IDF + Logistic Regression pipeline and a fine-tuned DistilBERT classifier are compared under a loss-threshold MIA, with utility measured by development accuracy and macro F1. DistilBERT reached 0.9466 accuracy and 0.9460 macro F1 against 0.8756 and 0.8727 for Logistic Regression, yet both models leaked membership signal (Attack AUC 0.5615 and 0.5800, respectively). Two mitigations were tested. Stronger regularization reduced leakage for Logistic Regression at a visible utility cost, whereas fine-tuning DistilBERT for 2 epochs instead of 3 reduced leakage with negligible accuracy loss. Lightweight training adjustments can improve the privacy-utility trade-off without complex defenses.
summary_zh: 成员推理攻击（MIA）试图判断特定记录是否被用于训练目标模型，该隐私风险在自然语言处理（NLP）领域尤为突出，因为训练数据可能包含敏感的用户文本。本文针对GLUE SST-2情感数据集构建了文本分类任务成员推理脆弱性的受控基准，对比TF-IDF+逻辑回归流水线和微调后的DistilBERT分类器在损失阈值型成员推理攻击下的表现，采用开发集准确率和宏F1值作为效用评估指标。实验结果表明，DistilBERT的准确率达0.9466，宏F1值达0.9460，优于逻辑回归的0.8756和0.8727，但两类模型均泄露了成员信号（攻击AUC分别为0.5615和0.5800）。本文测试了两类缓解方案：更强的正则化可降低逻辑回归的成员泄露，但会带来明显的效用损失；而将DistilBERT的微调轮次从3轮减少到2轮，可在准确率损失可忽略的前提下降低成员泄露。轻量级的训练调整方案可在无需复杂防御机制的前提下优化隐私-效用权衡。

title: Structurally Speaking: Motif-Oriented Graph Captioning through Bidirectional Graph-Text Translation
title_zh: 从结构视角出发：基于双向图-文本翻译的面向图模体的图描述生成
authors: Hsiao-Ying Lu, Dongyu Liu, Kwan-Liu Ma
abstract: Graph captions should help readers understand graph structure, rather than simply translate adjacency matrices into long textual edge lists. A useful graph caption abstracts connectivity into recognizable motifs, such as hubs, paths, cycles, cliques, and bridges, because these motifs provide compact structural units that are easier to read, compare, and recover. In this paper, we study motif-oriented graph captioning as a bidirectional graph-text translation task, where captions must both preserve enough topology for graph recovery and express the graph through concise motif-level descriptions. We show that direct prompting of GPT-5.1 often produces graph-recoverable captions by enumerating node-to-node connections, but these captions are verbose and can contain inconsistent motif interpretations. To address this gap, we introduce Structurally Speaking, a lightweight structured prompting protocol that guides translation between explicit connectivity and motif-level abstraction. Experiments on a synthetic motif-based dataset show that structured prompting produces shorter and more motif-consistent captions while maintaining comparable graph recovery. These results suggest that explicit topology-to-motif reasoning guidance can make LLM-generated graph captions more interpretable without model fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 图描述应当帮助读者理解图结构，而非简单地将邻接矩阵转换为冗长的文本边列表。实用的图描述会将连通性抽象为可识别的图模体，例如枢纽、路径、环、团和桥，这类模体提供了紧凑的结构单元，更便于阅读、对比和还原。本文将面向图模体的图描述生成作为双向图-文本翻译任务开展研究，要求生成的描述既保留足够的拓扑信息以支持图还原，又能通过简洁的模体级描述表达图的核心结构。研究发现，直接对GPT-5.1进行提示通常会通过枚举节点间连接生成可支持图还原的描述，但这类描述十分冗长，且可能存在模体解释不一致的问题。为解决该缺陷，本文提出Structurally Speaking轻量结构化提示协议，可引导显式连通性与模体级抽象之间的双向翻译。在合成模体数据集上的实验表明，结构化提示可生成更短、模体一致性更高的描述，同时保持相当的图还原性能。上述结果说明，显式的拓扑到模体推理引导可在无需模型微调的前提下，提升大语言模型生成的图描述的可解释性。

title: Relatively Smart II: Tractable or Semi-Supervised Instance-Optimal Learning
title_zh: 相对智能学习II：可计算或半监督的实例最优学习
authors: Shaddin Dughmi, Alireza F. Pour
abstract: We continue the study of relatively smart learning, introduced by Dughmi and Pour (2026), which asks a supervised learner to compete, marginal by marginal, with every distribution-fixed error guarantee soundly certifiable from unlabeled data. They showed that the One-Inclusion Graph (OIG) learner is relatively smart with a quadratic sample-complexity blowup, and that no relatively smart learner can do better, leaving open whether ERM or another natural or tractable learner achieves comparable guarantees. They also left open whether the blowup can be restricted to unlabeled data.Our firs results shows that ERM---and in fact any proper consistent learner---is relatively smart for binary classification in the distribution-free setting. We show that a small certifiable error with $m$ samples implies a similarly small error on the uniform distribution over a random sample of size $O(m^2)$, yielding a cover of size at most $2^{m+1}$ on that sample. This suffices to control the error of proper consistent learners with $O(m^2)$ samples.We then show that semi-supervised relatively smart learning is information-theoretically possible with a quadratic blowup only in unlabeled sample complexity and no blowup in labeled sample complexity. The learner uses a natural generalization of OIG to a leave-most-out transductive problem, where labels of part of a finite pool are revealed and the remaining labels are predicted.Finally, this label efficiency comes at a cost in simplicity and tractability. If the hypothesis class is accessed only through an agnostic ERM oracle, any semi-supervised relatively smart learner with substantially sub-quadratic labeled-sample blowup requires super-polynomially many oracle calls. This holds even when the marginal is given explicitly, and thus also yields an intractability result for distribution-fixed learning that may be of independent interest.
summary_zh: 我们延续了Dughmi和Pour（2026）提出的相对智能学习研究方向，该方向要求有监督学习者逐边际地与所有可从无标注数据中可靠证明的分布固定误差保证展开竞争。此前研究表明，单包含图（One-Inclusion Graph, OIG）学习者具备相对智能特性，但其样本复杂度会产生二次方的膨胀，且不存在表现更优的相对智能学习者，不过经验风险最小化（Empirical Risk Minimization, ERM）或其他自然可计算学习者能否达到相当的性能保证仍待验证，同时无标注数据的膨胀能否被限制也尚未明确。本文第一项研究结果表明，在无分布设定的二分类任务中，ERM以及所有恰当一致学习者都具备相对智能特性：我们证明，m个样本得到的可证明小误差，对应大小为O(m²)的随机样本上的均匀分布也存在相近的小误差，进而在该样本上生成大小不超过2^(m+1)的覆盖集，足以让恰当一致学习者仅用O(m²)个样本即可控制误差。随后我们证明，半监督相对智能学习在信息论层面是可行的，其仅在无标注样本复杂度上产生二次方膨胀，标注样本复杂度无额外膨胀。该学习者将OIG方法自然推广到留多数样本的转导问题中，即先暴露有限样本池的部分标签，再预测剩余样本的标签。最后我们指出，这种标签效率的提升是以简洁性和可计算性为代价的：如果仅通过不可知ERM预言机访问假设类，任何标注样本膨胀远低于二次方的半监督相对智能学习者都需要调用超多项式次预言机。该结论即使在边际分布明确给出时依然成立，同时也可推导出分布固定学习的一个难解性结果，具备独立的研究价值。

title: Learning Orthogonal Multi-Index Models Beyond Small Initialization: Incremental Learning, Competitive Dynamics and Symmetry
title_zh: 超越小初始化场景的正交多指标模型学习：增量学习、竞争动力学与对称性
authors: Mo Zhou, Weihang Xu, Simon S. Du, Maryam Fazel
abstract: Recent work has identified incremental learning in shallow networks trained on single-index and multi-index models. However, existing analyses often rely on simplifying settings, such as small initialization, correlation loss, or layer-wise training. These choices reduce neuron interactions and leave some feature learning dynamics under standard initialization unexplored. We study training dynamics for polynomial-width two-layer networks learning orthogonal multi-index targets under standard initialization using polynomially many samples. We first prove that incremental learning still occurs: the loss decreases sequentially according to the Hermite expansion of the target, with lower-order components learned before higher-order components recover the individual target directions. In this standard initialization regime, training also shows a competitive reallocation of parameter mass: after the total mass fits the target mean and stabilizes, mass shifts into the target subspace and then concentrates on aligned neurons. Our theoretical analysis uses slightly modified gradient flow, while vanilla gradient descent empirically exhibits the same qualitative dynamics. Technically, we introduce a symmetry-based finite-width approximation via symmetrized networks, rather than comparing directly with an infinite-width limit. This yields better control of approximation errors and may be of independent interest.
summary_zh: 近期研究已经证实，在单指标和多指标模型上训练的浅层网络中存在增量学习现象。但现有分析通常依赖小初始化、相关损失或逐层训练等简化设定，这类设定弱化了神经元之间的交互，导致标准初始化下的部分特征学习动力学机制尚未得到解释。本文研究了多项式宽度的双层网络在标准初始化下学习正交多指标目标的训练动力学，训练过程仅使用多项式数量的样本。我们首先证明增量学习现象依然存在：损失会根据目标的埃尔米特展开式逐步下降，先学习低阶分量，之后高阶分量再恢复出各个目标方向。在该标准初始化场景下，训练过程还表现出参数质量的竞争重分配特性：总质量拟合目标均值并稳定后，参数质量会先转移到目标子空间，随后集中到对齐的神经元上。我们的理论分析采用了稍作修改的梯度流，而普通梯度下降在实证中也表现出相同的定性动力学特性。在技术层面，我们通过对称化网络引入了基于对称性的有限宽度近似，而非直接与无限宽度极限做对比，该方法可以更好地控制近似误差，具备独立的研究价值。

title: Certifying Lower Bounds for Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning under Adversarial State Perturbations
title_zh: 对抗状态扰动下风险敏感强化学习的下界证明
authors: Tong Li, Saunak Kumar Panda, Yisha Xiang
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) agents deployed in real-world environments are often vulnerable to adversarial perturbations in state observations, creating risks in safety-critical applications. Certification methods can improve robustness against adversarial perturbations by providing lower bounds on expected cumulative rewards. Existing certification methods, however, mainly focus on risk-neutral objectives. In this paper, we extend certification methods to risk-sensitive objectives by establishing lower bounds on the exponential utility of cumulative rewards under $l_{p}$-norm-bounded state adversarial perturbations ($1\leq p <\infty$). By introducing a $\phi$-divergence relaxation of the perturbation set, we formulate the risk-sensitive certification problem as a convex optimization and derive its dual to obtain a tractable approximation of the certified lower bound. We further propose an empirical method that improves certified lower bounds by selecting the training risk-aversion parameter $\beta$ independently of the risk level used during evaluation. Experiments on both OpenAI Gym environments and a machine replacement problem show that, compared to risk-neutral training, risk-averse training generally yields policies with higher certified lower bounds, particularly under larger perturbation budgets. Moreover, under both risk-neutral and risk-averse evaluation settings, increasing risk aversion during training leads to non-monotonic certification performance, where certified lower bounds initially improve but eventually decrease due to overly conservative policies.
summary_zh: 部署在真实环境中的强化学习（RL）智能体通常容易受到状态观测的对抗扰动影响，给安全关键场景的应用带来风险。证明方法可以通过给出期望累积奖励的下界，提升模型对抗扰动的鲁棒性。但现有证明方法主要面向风险中性目标。本文将证明方法扩展到风险敏感目标，针对l_p范数有界（1≤p<∞）的状态对抗扰动，建立累积奖励指数效用的下界。通过引入扰动集的φ散度松弛，我们将风险敏感证明问题建模为凸优化问题，推导其对偶形式，得到可计算的证明下界近似。我们进一步提出一种实证方法，通过独立于评估阶段使用的风险水平选择训练风险厌恶参数β，提升证明下界的效果。在OpenAI Gym环境和机器替换问题上的实验结果表明，与风险中性训练相比，风险厌恶训练得到的策略通常具备更高的证明下界，在扰动预算较大时优势尤为明显。此外，在风险中性和风险厌恶两种评估设定下，训练阶段风险厌恶程度的提升会导致证明性能呈现非单调性：证明下界先上升后下降，原因是过度保守的策略会导致性能受损。

title: Flow Duality and Source Geometry for Categorical Generation
title_zh: 分类生成的流对偶性与源几何特性
authors: Etrit Haxholli
abstract: Continuous and discrete flow matching are usually treated as separate constructions. This paper identifies a duality between them: projecting continuous convex-interpolant paths with one-hot targets through a position-wise argmax yields discrete convex-interpolant paths. The result requires source laws with appropriate coordinate symmetry and boundary regularity, and it makes the continuous source distribution an explicit design choice for categorical generation. We derive the induced discrete interpolation behavior for Gaussian, bounded-uniform, and centered negative-exponential sources, showing that different source geometries lead to qualitatively different transition timing and vocabulary-size dependence. Small visual diagnostics and a short language-modeling pilot suggest that these source-design effects can also appear in learned transports and early generative quality.
summary_zh: 连续流匹配和离散流匹配通常被视为两种独立的构造方法。本文揭示了二者之间的对偶性：将以独热向量为目标的连续凸插值路径通过逐位置argmax操作投影，即可得到离散凸插值路径。该结论要求源分布满足合适的坐标对称性和边界正则性，这使得连续源分布成为分类生成任务中可显式设计的选项。我们推导了高斯源、有界均匀源和中心负指数源对应的离散插值行为，证明不同的源几何特性会带来性质完全不同的转移时序和词汇表大小依赖关系。小规模可视化诊断和简短语言模型试点实验表明，这类源设计效应也会出现在学习到的传输过程和早期生成质量中。

title: Project Qualia: Recovering Experiential Music Structure from Session Co-occurrence Data
title_zh: Qualia项目：从会话共现数据中恢复体验式音乐结构
authors: Nizam Mohammed, Abu B. S. Rahman, Dimuthu D. K. Arachchige
abstract: This report presents results from Project Qualia, an ongoing effort to determine whether experiential similarity between songs, a structure not captured by genre or metadata taxonomies, can be recovered from real listening behavior. We constructed a large-scale dataset of listening sessions, comprising 1.29 billion scrobbles collected from 9,396 users via thethis http URLAPI and reduced through a preprocessing pipeline to 531.6 million training scrobbles across 28.6 million sessions. On this corpus, we trained a skip-gram Word2Vec model (Song2Vec), treating each session as a sentence and each track as a token. As anticipated, the resulting embedding space was dominated by artist identity, a consequence of single-artist runs within sessions. To test for a subtler, artist-independent signal, we developed an artist-residual procedure: subtracting each artist's centroid from its tracks' embeddings and evaluating whether the remainder retained structure.
